title: Family Office Services Analyst
description:
At BBH, Partnership is more than a form of ownership—it’s our approach to business and relationships. We know that supporting your professional and personal goals is the best way to help our clients and advance our business. We take that responsibility seriously. With a 200-year legacy and a shared passion for what’s next, this is the right place to build a fulfilling career.

Brown Brothers Harriman is currently recruiting a Family Office Services Analyst. In this role, you will support Private Banking by handling Bill Pay, Financial Projections, and Capital Call Services requests from the Front Office and clients. You will ensure that all tasks are completed in a timely and accurate manner while maintaining a high standard of excellence. You will interact with key internal stakeholders across the firm and work closely with Front Office teams, Compliance, Risk, and other teams within Capital Partners Operations and Administration. You will also drive continuous workflow enhancements to increase efficiency and address control gaps.

Some of your key responsibilities include:

Bill Pay/Capital Call Onboarding, Opening, and Maintenance

  • Liaise with the Front Office once new business has been won to begin the onboarding process and gain a clear understanding of the types of bills to be paid and the required documentation.
  • Act as a subject matter expert on all matters related to Bill Pay.
  • Analyze payments to ensure proper documentation is obtained from clients.
  • Liaise with third-party investment advisors to ensure access and proper setup for Capital Call Services.

Client Service

  • Develop strong working relationships with Front Office Relationship teams and other Private Banking support groups.
  • Act as the primary point of escalation for issues.
  • Address client inquiries in a timely manner.
  • Use sound judgment to resolve problems.
  • Escalate urgent and critical issues to management when necessary.

Bill Payment/eMoney/Capital Call Services

  • Set up payments by leveraging Bill.com’s ACH network.
  • Troubleshoot, research, and resolve break items.
  • Gain an understanding of each type of cash movement (ACH, check, and wire) and how to resolve related issues.
  • Ensure client bills are processed in a timely and accurate manner.
  • Process capital calls for clients in a timely and accurate manner.
  • Run and validate client financial projection reports.
  • Act as an escalation point for more junior team members.

Process/Productivity Improvement

  • Identify efficiencies to improve individual productivity.
  • Gain an understanding of the big picture and how specific functions impact the firm.
  • Communicate professionally and constructively to resolve issues effectively and minimize risk and exposure.
  • Assess current processes and provide suggestions for streamlining when necessary.
  • Work on small ad hoc projects as needed.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • At least 2+ years of experience supporting family office services
  • Ability to design efficient workflows.
  • Ability to identify, escalate, and resolve problems and issues.
  • Ability to communicate professionally through effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Demonstrates effective time management skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail, time management, and organizational skills.
  • Strong interpersonal, collaboration, and relationship management skills.
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize tasks.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment.
  • Ability to meet deadlines and work well under pressure.
  • Proactive, goal-oriented self-starter.
  • Possesses an understanding of AML/KYC.
  • Demonstrates risk awareness and the ability to identify red flags.
  • Solid understanding of Bill.com and eMoney is a plus.
  • Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills.

This role is based in our New York City location and is a hybrid role, with a minimum of three days per week in office.

Salary Range

$70k-$90k base salary + annual bonus target

BBH and its affiliates' compensation program includes base salary, discretionary bonuses, and profit-sharing. The anticipated base salary range(s) shown above are only for the indicated location(s) and may differ in other locations due to cost of living and labor considerations. Base salaries may vary based on factors such as skill, experience and qualification for the role. BBH's total rewards package recognizes your contributions with more than just a paycheck—providing you with benefits that enhance your experience at BBH from long-term savings, healthcare, and income protection to professional development opportunities and time off, our programs support your overall well-being.


We value diverse experiences. We value diverse experiences and transferrable skillsets. If your career hasn’t followed a traditional path, includes alternative experiences, or doesn’t meet every qualification or skill listed in the job description, please do go ahead and apply.

About BBH:

Brown Brothers Harriman (BBH) is a premier global financial services firm, known for premium service, specialist expertise, technology solutions and partnership approach to client management. Across Investor Services and Capital Partners, we work with an enviable roster of sophisticated clients who make BBH their first call when they are tackling their hardest challenges. Delivering for our clients and each other energizes us.

We believe that how we do our work is just as important as what we do. We are relentless problem solvers who know our best ideas come from collective debate and development—so we are never possessive about our ideas. Every day we come together as a diverse community of smart and caring people to deliver exceptional service and expert advice—creating success that lasts. No matter where you sit in the organization, everyone is empowered to contribute their ideas. BBHers can pick up the phone and call any colleague, and they are happy to help. Expanding your impact beyond your daily role is part of how we operate as trusted partners to one another.

We believe stability is a competitive advantage, but being stable means having the knowledge, skill, and discipline to evolve, often—pushing the boundaries of innovation. As a private partnership, every investment we make is in the relationships, technologies, products and development we believe are in the long-term interests of our clients and our people. Our long-tenured leaders are experts in their areas and are actively involved in the day-to day business, taking the time to provide guidance and mentoring to build the next generation of BBHers. Because we know, our success begins with yours.

title: Fraud / Financial Crime Product Counsel
description:
Job Description

Role Overview

FIS is seeking a senior Fraud / Financial Crime Product Counsel to provide strategic legal support for fraud prevention, financial crime compliance and integrity-focused products. This new role is part of FIS’s dedicated Product Counsel structure supporting Data, AI, Technology, Fraud, Financial Crime and Enterprise Platform priorities. The role reflects the growing importance of legal advice that is embedded directly into product development, especially where fraud, abuse, scams, financial crime and compliance controls must be considered by design.

The successful candidate will serve as the legal owner for assigned fraud and financial crime product portfolios, working as an integrated product counsel who understands the product, the regulatory environment, the client base and the operational realities of supporting banks and credit unions. FIS’s product counsel model requires attorneys to engage early, provide risk-calibrated advice and coordinate across compliance, privacy, security, litigation and other specialists to deliver practical, unified guidance. This role is ideal for a senior lawyer who can help FIS build products that are resistant to fraud, abuse and scams while preserving speed to market and client trust.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary legal resource for assigned fraud prevention, financial crime compliance and integrity-focused product portfolios, owning product legal strategy across ideation, design, launch, business-as-usual support and product sunset or migration.

  • Partner with product, fraud, compliance, data, technology, privacy, security, sales and business stakeholders to embed legal and regulatory considerations into product design and go-to-market planning.

  • Advise on regulatory lanes that may be implicated by fraud and financial crime products, including banking, payments, consumer protection, privacy, data protection and financial crimes considerations.

  • Help design product approaches that are resistant to fraud, abuse and scams by default, consistent with the dedicated integrity and financial-crime product counsel specialization identified in FIS’s Product Counsel structure.

  • Build legal roadmaps that align with fraud and financial crime product milestones, including issue spotting, approvals, contracting readiness, launch requirements and post-launch monitoring.

  • Maintain deep product and market knowledge, including product functionality, regulatory environment, target buyers, geographic markets, product roadmap, revenue priorities and sales pipeline.

  • Work closely with compliance counterparts to prevent gaps and duplicative work where legal and compliance responsibilities overlap.

  • Support client-facing positions on fraud, compliance, security, privacy, subcontracting, service levels, audit, incident response and product-specific operational terms.

  • Own and maintain contract templates, solution terms, specifications, product documentation and approved negotiation guidance for assigned fraud and financial crime products.

  • Support sales pipeline calls, RFP responses and client negotiations where product-specific fraud, financial crime, compliance, security, data or regulatory issues require legal input.

  • Identify third-party dependencies, critical vendors, network changes, data providers and subcontractors that may affect product risk, contractual commitments or client obligations.

  • Advise on disputes, operational issues and litigation support involving fraud or financial crime products, including potential exposure, available remedies, change management, specifications, third-party dependencies and client communications.

  • Train legal colleagues, business teams and sellers on product functionality, key contacts, approved templates, fallback positions, non-negotiables, pass-through obligations and recurring negotiation trends.

  • Drive scalable process improvements, including intake triage, escalation discipline, precedent language, legal playbooks, training materials and backup coverage for assigned products.

Required Qualifications

  • Juris Doctor from an accredited law school and active membership in good standing with at least one U.S. state bar.

  • Minimum of 9 years of relevant legal experience, with substantial experience in financial services, financial technology, fraud prevention, financial crime compliance, payments, banking, risk management, compliance products or related regulatory environments.

  • Demonstrated ability to provide product-facing legal advice across the full lifecycle of regulated technology products, including ideation, design, launch, contracting, support, disputes and product retirement.

  • Strong understanding of legal and regulatory considerations relevant to banking, payments, consumer protection, privacy, data protection and financial crimes product development.

  • Experience coordinating with compliance teams and other legal specialists to deliver practical, integrated advice on complex product issues.

  • Experience supporting commercial contracting, RFP responses, client negotiations, template ownership and escalation of non-standard client positions.

  • Ability to advise under uncertainty and make risk-calibrated recommendations that balance product velocity, regulatory expectations, client trust and enterprise risk.

  • Strong interpersonal skills and demonstrated ability to build credibility with product, sales, compliance, privacy, security and senior business stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience advising on fraud detection, AML, sanctions, scams, identity, transaction monitoring, risk scoring, compliance workflow, banking operations or payment network products.

  • Experience supporting bank or credit union technology clients, including familiarity with oversight expectations, audit requests, security reviews and vendor risk management processes.

  • Experience advising on data flows, data usage, AI-enabled decisioning, model governance, monitoring controls or technology features used in fraud and financial crime products.

  • Experience developing approved legal positions for recurring client asks involving audit rights, service levels, subcontractors, security, incident response, liability or regulatory questionnaires.

  • Experience working in a high-volume sales and contracting environment where product counsel must anticipate deal issues early and coordinate escalation before client positions are anchored.

  • Demonstrated ability to train legal, sales and business teams on complex regulated products and translate legal requirements into practical product and go-to-market guidance.

Why FIS

FIS’s Product Counsel model is built to position legal as a partner, not a checkpoint, and to help product teams advance business goals while complying with governing laws and regulations. In fraud and financial crime, that model is especially important because product design, regulatory expectations, client trust, data usage and operational controls often converge. This role offers a senior lawyer the opportunity to help shape products that protect clients, support responsible innovation and strengthen FIS’s position as a trusted financial technology leader.

title: 플릿 운영(fleet operation) 및 자산 관리 매니저
description:
About

[쏘카의 차량관리팀을 ​소개합니다]
• 차량관리팀은 카셰어링 서비스에 제공되는 플릿(Fleet)의 전반적인 운영 기획 및 관리를 책임지는 팀입니다. 차량에서 발생하는 데이터를 기반으로 문제를 선제적으로 발견하고, 제어 단말기·통신·차량 비치 자산까지 플릿 운영의 전 영역을 직접 다루며 서비스 품질의 기반을 만들어갑니다. 일회성 대응에 그치지 않고, 지표와 운영 체계를 함께 구축해 문제가 반복되지 않는 구조를 만드는 것까지 책임집니다.

Responsibilities

[담당하시게 될 업무를 소개합니다]
1) 선제적 차량 관리
• 차량 기능·운행패턴·장애 데이터 기반의 이상 징후 탐지 및 선제적 대응 체계 구축
• 장애 유형별 대응 프로세스 설계 및 재발 방지를 위한 운영 체계화
2) 제어 단말기 및 통신 관리
• 카셰어링 서비스용 제어 단말기 장착 계획 수립 및 운영
• 단말기 통신 상태 모니터링 및 장애 대응 프로세스 관리
3) 차량 비치 자산 관리
• 차량 내 비치 자산(비품 등)의 재고·배치·회수 프로세스 관리
• 자산 손실·분실 이슈에 대한 구조적 개선안 마련
4) 데이터 기반 운영 개선
• BigQuery 등을 활용한 핵심 플릿 지표 모니터링 및 대시보드 구축
• 운영상의 Pain Point를 데이터로 규명하고 개선 시나리오 수립
5) 협력사 및 유관부서 협업
• 단말기 장착·정비 등 협력사와의 계약 및 KPI/SLA 관리
• 사업·프로덕트 등 유관부서와 협업하여 운영 정책 및 시스템 기능 개선 반영

Requirements

[이런 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다]
• 플릿 운영, 차량 관리, 또는 유사한 운영 관리 경력 5년 이상 보유자
• SQL(BigQuery) 등을 활용해 직접 데이터를 다루고, 지표를 설계해 추적 체계까지 만들어본 경험이 있는 분
• 프로세스 공백을 스스로 발견하고 구조화하고, 주어진 역할에 안주하지 않고 기회를 선제적으로 발굴하는 오너십을 가진 분
• 데이터를 근거로 협력사·유관 부서와의 협상·커뮤니케이션에 강점이 있는 분
• 가설 ＞ 검증 ＞ 수정의 빠른 사이클에 익숙하고, 틀렸을 때 방향을 빠르게 바꿀 수 있는 분

Preferred

[이런 분이면 더욱 좋습니다]
• AI 도구(ChatGPT, Claude 등)를 활용해 반복 업무 자동화 및 효율화를 실현해본 분
• 공유 모빌리티 또는 관련 O2O 서비스 종사 경험이 있는 분
• 차량 단말기, IoT, 통신 장비 등 하드웨어 연계 운영 경험이 있는 분
• 협업/운영 도구 활용 및 자동화 구축 경험자
• 정책·전략 문서를 논리적으로 작성하고 내부 설득에 활용한 경험이 있는 분
• 거시적 운영 구조와 현장 디테일을 동시에 이해하는 제너럴리스트형 기획자

[동료의 한마디]
• 기획, 데이터, 현장이 만나는 팀에서 플릿 운영의 처음과 끝을 그리며, 데이터 기반 분석부터 협력사 운영까지 폭넓은 역량을 쌓아가실 수 있습니다.

Benefits

[가족까지 생각해요]
• 임산부 단축 근무 및 직장 어린이집 지원
• 경조휴가 및 경조사비 지원

[라이프를 함께해요]
• 사내 동호회, 소모임, 밍글링 지원

[건강을 챙겨드려요]
• 본인 및 가족 1인 건강검진 지원
• 마음 건강 프로그램 운영
• 사내 간식 및 커피 지원
• 사내 힐링룸 운영

** 혜택 및 복지는 회사 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.

description:
ABOUT GREYSTAR


Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit .

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

Ensures that vacant units meet the established quality standards for re-leasing by performing technical and mechanical
work that ensures the timely turn of all vacant apartment homes to market ready condition that meet the Company’s
standards for occupancy.

JOB DESCRIPTION

  • Completes all needed repairs and improvements to apartment homes prior to resident move-in by following the community’s make-ready checklist.
  • Ensures apartment homes have been properly caulked and sealed as needed around windows, sink areas, toilets, bathtubs, and showers.
  • Inspects all sheetrock for damage, and repairs and/or replaces as needed.
  • Performs touch-up paints for vacant and occupied units as directed by Service Supervisor or Community Manager.
  • Assists in maintaining the grounds, common areas, and amenities by picking up trash and debris, pressure-washing breezeways and pool areas, performing general cleaning, and painting curbs and signage as needed.
  • Supports cost-cutting and expense control programs by fixing rather than replacing parts when possible, not being wasteful with materials and supplies, and practicing the correct use for tools and equipment.
  • Completes make-ready checklist and all other required maintenance documentation in a timely manner as required by the Supervisor or Manager.
  • Complies with Greystar’s safety and risk-management policies by attending and participating in the community’s routine safety meetings, completing required training on OSHA and other safety related laws and requirements, and by reporting accidents and incidents promptly and accurately.
  • Demonstrates customer services skills by treating residents and others with respect, answering resident questions, responding sensitively to complaints about maintenance services, and completing assigned work orders with efficiency and urgency.

Physical Demands:

  • Incumbents need to be able to stand, walk, and/or sit for extended periods of time and bend, stoop, climb ladders, reach, carry objects, and crawl in confined areas.
  • Incumbents must be able to work inside and outside in all weather conditions (rain, snow, heat, hail, wind, sleet).
  • Incumbents must be able to push, pull, lift, carry, or maneuver weights of up to twenty-five (25) pounds independently and fifty (50) pounds with assistance.
  • Rare or regular travel may be required to assist other properties as needed, attend training classes, business meetings, or other situations necessary for the accomplishment of some or all of the daily responsibilities of this position.
  • Incumbents must be able to work a flexible work schedule, which includes taking “call” during evenings, weekends and holidays.

#LI-RS2

The hourly range for this job is $19 - $21.


Additional Compensation:


Many factors go into determining employee pay within the posted range including business requirements, prior experience, current skills and geographical location.

  • Corporate Positions: In addition to the base salary, this role may be eligible to participate in a quarterly or annual bonus program based on individual and company performance.
  • Onsite Property Positions: In addition to the base salary, this role may be eligible to participate in weekly, monthly, and/or quarterly bonus programs.

Robust Benefits Offered*:

  • Competitive Medical, Dental, Vision, and Disability & Life insurance benefits. Low (free basic) employee Medical costs for employee-only coverage; costs discounted after 3 and 5 years of service.
  • Generous Paid Time off. All new hires start with 15 days of vacation, 4 personal days, 10 sick days, and 11 paid holidays. Plus your birthday off after 1 year of service! Additional vacation accrued with tenure.
  • For onsite team members, onsite housing discount at Greystar-managed communities are available subject to discount and unit availability.
  • 6-Week Paid Sabbatical after 10 years of service (and every 5 years thereafter).
  • 401(k) with Company Match up to 6% of pay after 6 months of service.
  • Paid Parental Leave and lifetime Fertility Benefit reimbursement up to $10,000 (includes adoption or surrogacy).
  • Employee Assistance Program.
  • Critical Illness, Accident, Hospital Indemnity, Pet Insurance and Legal Plans.
  • Charitable giving program and benefits.

*Benefits offered for full-time employees. For Union and Prevailing Wage roles, compensation and benefits may vary from the listed information above due to Collective Bargaining Agreements and/or local governing authority.

Greystar does not conduct any interviews via text or messaging, and all communication will come from official Greystar email addresses (@greystar.com). If you receive suspicious requests, please report them immediately to AskHR@greystar.com.

September 11, 2026

title: Senior AI Security Architect
description:
Become a part of our caring community

*(Selected candidate will be required to live within 60 mins of one of the following metro locations OR be willing to relocate to within 12 months of hire date: Louisville KY, NYC Metro, Dallas Metro, Charlotte NC Metro, Tampa, Miami, Washington DC metro, Chicago, Boston, Atlanta, Nashville)
The Senior Security Architect for AI works with EIP Department leaders and Humana enterprise stakeholders to identify, define, and develop security architecture requirements and secure designs for AI technology solutions across Humana's business, information technology, and security domains. The Security Architect leads the development of technical architecture & designs, develop security requirements, perform threat modeling and ensures alignment of security & risk imperatives with business priorities.

The Security Architect is responsible for the high-level design and patterns of security program infrastructures to enable the protection of Humana tools, data, systems, and networks. Working with EIP Leaders, the security architect drives alignment between the EIP security strategy, security architecture and infrastructure, and Humana's overall business and technology strategic priorities. In this capacity, the role is responsible for planning, designing, and proposing architectural patterns or security enhancements for Humana's information security and technology infrastructures. The role works with EIP and Humana leaders to review and reconcile Humana business priorities with EIP security requirements. The role engages with relevant EIP stakeholders to identify current and emerging security threats and works to design security architecture elements to mitigate threats as they emerge. Additionally, the role actively works to identify gaps within existing EIP reference architecture and designs updates to impacted security architecture elements to mitigate emerging threats.

Performs and oversees efforts to conduct threat modeling, risk analyses and security assessments of relevant enterprise / EIP infrastructure. Develops and manages security requirements for GenAI, model, MCP, Agentic AI solutions and software integration with Humana systems. Ensures EIP and Humana stakeholder security requirements are necessary to protect Humana's business functions and are adequately addressed in all aspects of enterprise architecture (i.e., reference models, segment and solution architectures).

The Security Architect will focus on AI security threats, designs, and secure implementation of AI processes and solutions (applications and software). This role works with relevant EIP stakeholders to ensure the associated AI security standards, templates, and security safeguards & controls for Humana's AI application architecture are in place. The role identifies opportunities to facilitate process and tooling automation, and where possible, within existing security architecture patterns. The individual in this role may participate in the research, evaluation, and implementation of AI testing tools, frameworks, and utilities for Humana's enterprise and EIP Departments.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ Experience in technical Cybersecurity architecture
  • 1+ Experience in Artificial Intelligence Security
  • 1+ years of experience integrating Cybersecurity technologies with existing technologies
  • Experience implementing Cybersecurity technologies with enterprise-wide impact

  • CISSP or CEH certification
  • Experience in AI Security

  • Architectural Threat Modeling
  • Business Architecture
  • Cloud Infrastructure Security
  • Cloud Security Architecture
  • Computer Protection Components Configuration (e.g., hardware firewalls, servers, routers)
  • Information Security Architecture
  • Information Technology Security
  • Multi-Level Security/Cross Domain/Hybrid Solutions Design
  • Security Program Development
  • Security Strategy & Planning
  • Security Strategy Transformation
  • Technical Problems Troubleshooting

  • A minimum standard speed for optimal performance of 25x10 (25mpbs download x 10mpbs upload) is required.

TM Camping Statement of Faith


The Statement Of Faith outlines the beliefs of TM Camping . All beliefs are listed and founded in God's Word, the Bible.


Preamble


TM Camping , in accordance with the historic Baptist tradition, hold to Believers Baptism by Immersion, Liberty of Conscience, the Separation of Church and state, and the Priesthood of the Believer. We also affirm the following distinctive which need emphasis at the present time:


I. THE AUTHORITY OF SCRIPTURE


The Bible is the inspired, authoritative and infallible Word of God and is our sole rule of faith and practice. It is the standard by which all human conduct and creeds should be tried.


II. THE TRINITY


There is only one true and living God who is manifested in three eternal and coequal person; Father, Son and Holy Spirit. God possesses holiness, omnipotence, omniscience, omnipresence, love, mercy, and all other perfections. All humankind owed to Him supreme faith and obedience.


III. HUMANKIND


Humankind has been created in the image of God but through Adam’s fall is now sinful, lost and condemned. By deliberate choice all participate in sin which is open rebellion to God’s law. Notwithstanding the fall, all human life through creation has value and dignity.


IV. JUSTIFICATION BY FAITH


Human beings can be forgiven of sin and justified solely through the redeeming work of Jesus Christ who died for sinners and rose again from the dead. Only by repentance from sin and faith in Jesus Christ the Lord can acceptance with God be attained.


V. REGENERATION


Regeneration is the work of the Holy Spirit by which the believer receives a new nature from God. Christian growth or sanctification is the continuation of the new life principle which begins in the new birth.


VI. THE CHURCH


The church in its widest sense includes all believers of all ages. The church is manifested visibly in the local body of baptized believers who covenant together to worship, observe the ordinances, and evangelize.


VII. HUMAN DESTINY


Jesus Christ will eventually return visibly at which time He will raise the dead and judge all people. Believers will enjoy an eternal state of blessedness in heaven while unbelievers will experience eternal separation from God in hell.


VIII. EVANGELISM AND SOCIAL CONCERN


The church has been called to preach the gospel so that individual people can receive salvation. Also the church is to become involved in the improvement of society by advocating biblical principles which militate against poverty, racism, violence, and all forms of injustice against humankind.


IX. HUMAN SEXUALITY


God’s design is that man and woman either be joined together in a perpetual monogamous relationship or live in a single state. Extra-marital sex, adultery and homosexuality are inconsistent with biblical teaching.


Faith History


At TM Camping we desire to have a distinctly Christian atmosphere and influence. Though campers and attendees come from many Christian and non-Christian backgrounds, all are included in chapel services, prayer, devotions, etc. Ministry team members participate in leading campers, attendees and other staff in these and other Christian activities. In addition, no matter where one works, all staff are expected to live exemplary Christian lives before campers and staff alike.


In applying for a ministry staff or management position, you are subscribing to a high moral, ethical and spiritual life style and give assurance that you will try to lead campers and staff, in both word and deed, to practical, real faith for themselves. The work done here influences eternity! We are excited about how God is using our ministry to impact people and other ministries throughout the world. If you are hired, we hope that as you get to know us and experience God’s work here, you will love this ministry as much as we do!


We seek to be a group of people who care for our guests and work as a team. It is our desire that every employee and their entire family feel part of the ministry team here at TM Camping . title: Board Member
description:
Board Member Description:

CCJ's Board of Directors is the organization's legal, governing body. Board members work collectively to advance CCJ's mission: improving policy and regulations for the oversight of fossil fuel extraction and use, educating, empowering, and organizing coalfield residents, and protecting public and environmental health, on behalf of communities that have been extracted from for decades. Board members provide fiscal oversight and strategic guidance to ensure CCJ remains a sound, effective organization in service of that work.


Responsibilities:

  • Attend quarterly Board meetings (75% attendance expected annually) and review materials in advance
  • Vote on corporate matters, including officer elections and other governance decisions
  • Serve as the sole member of CCJ's affiliated c4, including electing its board
  • Serve on the Executive Committee or other committees as appointed
  • Uphold fiduciary duties of care, loyalty, and obedience, and stay familiar with CCJ's governing documents
  • Disclose conflicts of interest and protect confidential information
  • Respect staff roles: the Board governs collectively and supervises only the Executive Director (including an annual 360 review); the ED supervises all other staff
  • Represent CCJ responsibly in public statements, and volunteer time to further the mission


Compensation:

This is an unpaid volunteer position. No compensation is provided for service as a Board Member.


We're looking for Board Members who bring:

  • Commitment to CCJ's core mission: preventing the harmful effects of fossil fuel extraction and use, and pursuing restorative justice in coalfield communities
  • Commitment to public health and the wellbeing of communities affected by extraction
  • Commitment to our communities: everyone deserves to stay rooted where they live, not be pushed out by the money that sustains chronic and systemic harm
  • Willingness to serve in a fiduciary capacity with care, diligence, and good judgment
  • Lived experience with the impacts of extraction, or relevant professional experience in areas such as nonprofit governance, legal, finance, community organizing, or communications
  • Ability to attend quarterly board meetings (in person or by teleconference) and contribute to committee work


How to Apply:

Open on a rolling basis; applications go to the Board Chair for review and are kept on file for future reference.


Interested applicants should submit a letter addressed to the Board Chair that:

  • Introduces yourself: who you are, your background, and your connection to coalfield communities (whether from Washington and Greene counties, living here now, or drawn to this work through other lived or professional experience)
  • Speaks to CCJ's mission: in your own words, what does justice for communities impacted by fossil fuel extraction mean to you, and why does this work matter?
  • Shows your commitment: describe a time you've stood up for your community, whether through organizing, advocacy, mutual aid, or another form of showing up for people
  • Shares what you'd bring: what skills, relationships, or lived experience would you bring to CCJ's Board, and what draws you to serve in this role specifically
  • Confirms your capacity: your availability to commit to quarterly Board meetings and committee work


We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and lived experiences, whether born and raised in Washington and Greene counties or living here now, and regardless of professional background.

  • Partner with COO senior leaders and regional/business line leaders to define priorities, establish clear objectives, and translate strategic direction into actionable plans.

  • Drive the annual planning cycle for the COO portfolio, including strategic priorities, business plans, performance objectives, and resource alignment.
  • Monitor emerging trends, business performance, and strategic risks to inform planning and executive decision-making.

2. Initiatives Planning & Management

  • Define and structure high-priority COO initiatives by clarifying the business problem, desired outcomes, scope, dependencies, and decision points.

  • Align senior stakeholders on priorities, outcomes, and choices before initiatives move into implementation.

3. Initiative Implementation

  • Lead a team responsible for moving approved COO initiatives from decision to delivery, with clear ownership and execution plans.
  • Establish the governance, operating rhythm, milestones, and decision processes needed to keep initiatives on track.
  • Mobilize business units, support functions, and delivery teams to execute agreed plans and resolve issues quickly.
  • Track progress against milestones, risks, KPIs, and expected benefits, escalating decisions when needed.
  • Ensure implementation delivers intended business outcomes and embeds sustainable improvements across the COO organization.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR


  • 10 - 12 years relevant financial experience; including 3 – 5 years in strategy, or strategy implementation is a nice to have.
  • Strong understanding of the financing business is important to ensure initiatives are practical, field-ready, and aligned with client and business realities
  • The ideal candidate would have both BDC business knowledge and project work experience allowing them to drive execution and stakeholder alignment while ensuring relevant, actionable and field ready strategies.
  • Proven ability to influence executives, facilitate alignment, and drive decisions across diverse stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex, sensitive, cross-functional mandates simultaneously.
  • Experience translating strategy into executable plans, including roadmaps, governance, success metrics, implementation plans, and operating model considerations.
  • Strong people leadership skills, with the ability to build, coach, and motivate a high-performing team.
  • Superior executive communication skills, including clear, concise, decision-oriented documents and presentations.
  • Strong business judgment, tact, discretion, and comfort operating in a senior leadership environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree in commerce, business administration, strategy, finance, or a related field; graduate degree considered an asset.

title: Senior UX Product Designer
description:
Role Overview: As a Senior UX Product Designer for the Deloitte DT-US Product Engineering team, you will be tasked with solving complex challenges through elegant, user-centered design solutions. Our ideal candidate is a versatile design generalist with deep expertise in interaction design. You should feel equally at home shaping big-picture workflow and strategy as you are prototyping details visual and interaction elements. This role requires a proven track-record of experience-driven innovation. Join us in shaping the future of design!

The team: US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte's primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte's success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world's largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design engaging and intuitive user experiences using an iterative lean UX approach of continuous improvement
  • Create big-picture workflows as well as execute detailed visual & interaction design
  • Create user-friendly designs that enhance usability and optimize the overall user experience, while identifying design challenges and proposing elegant, effective solutions.
  • Produce all design assets including concept designs, user flows, wireframes, user scenarios, journey maps, mockups, etc. that support intuitive and seamless user interactions.
  • Conduct heuristic evaluations of existing products to identify areas for improvement.
  • Develop innovative approaches to complex design problems, presenting your ideas through mockups, presentations, and detailed design specifications.
  • Work within a small, empowered product team to balance business objectives with user needs, collaborating with engineers to ensure smooth implementation of designs.
  • Understand business priorities together with user needs to create impactful experiences
  • Uphold high standards of user-centered design, iterating quickly and testing designs to enhance usability and consistency across touchpoints.
  • Collaborate with user researchers to inform design decisions, contributing to studies that explore unresolved user interface issues and opportunities.
  • Continuously challenge design effectiveness, monitor behavioral analytics, and suggest improvements to optimize user experiences.
  • Contribute to the overall design framework, ensuring consistent design language and experiences across the product suite.
  • Ask insightful questions, take calculated risks, and champion new ideas to drive innovation.
  • Stay up to date with the latest UX trends, best practices, and methodologies in areas like information architecture, interaction design, and usability.
  • Operate effectively in both collaborative environments with other UX designers and autonomously when acting as the sole UX designer on a product squad.
  • Deliver high-quality UX work on time, showcasing your expertise in user experience design and detailed interactions.

Qualifications:

Required:
  • 5+ years as an interaction or product designer with a strong track record of crafting user interfaces that engage and delight users.
  • Deep understanding of interactive designprinciples, consistently delivering simple, elegant, and aesthetically pleasing interfaces rooted in usability and accessibility.
  • Proficient in designing for both desktop and mobile platforms, with a focus on responsive and adaptive design that enhances the user experience across devices.
  • Driven by a passion for solving user pain points, leveraging design thinking and user feedback to create seamless experiences.
  • Highly creative and analytical, able to navigate between strategic vision and hands-on execution, ensuring solutions are innovative and intuitive.
  • Collaborative and open-minded, eager to contribute to team success while continuously learning and iterating on designs based on feedback.
  • Thrives in dynamic, fast-paced environments, iterating quickly to incorporate feedback and improve outcomes.
  • Deeply passionate about UX and innovation, constantly exploring new design trends and methodologies to stay ahead.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, able to prioritize tasks effectively and work independently to meet deadlines.
  • Proficient in industry-standard UX tools, including Sketch, Adobe CC, Figma, Axure, InVision, UXPin, and Balsamiq, ensuring efficient design workflows.
  • Degree in Interaction Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Cognitive Psychology, or a related field
  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.
  • A strong portfolio or samples of work demonstrating experience and UX skills is required
  • Candidates must be located within a commutable distance to one of the select locations available for this role
  • Ability to work in your local office at a minimum of 3 days per week

description:
About InterContinental Los Angeles Downtown

As the tallest building west of Chicago, InterContinental Los Angeles Downtown will forever elevate the city skyline.     • Vendors – to ensure adequate inventory of supplies and equipment, to discuss pricing or service issues, to resolve any vendor performance issues, etc.

    • Regulatory agencies – regarding safety and compliance matters

    • Other contacts as needed (professional organizations, community groups, local media)

Training & Team Leadership

  • Ensure all colleagues and direct reports are properly trained, certified (as required), and equipped to perform their roles effectively. Educate and train all colleagues in compliance with federal, state and local laws and safety regulations.

  • Reinforce service standards using current SOPs, checklists, and training materials.

  • Lead ongoing service training programs, ensuring consistent delivery through testing and service audits.

  • Collaborate cross-departmentally to promote teamwork and seamless service execution.

  • Conduct regular performance reviews and coaching sessions to support career development and succession planning with direct reports and colleagues.

Operations Management

  • Oversee daily operations across the outlets and food & beverage programs, ensuring service excellence and adherence to brand standards.

  • Serve as Manager on Duty as needed, ensuring consistent operational standards.

  • Conduct routine facility inspections to maintain cleanliness, safety, and brand compliance.

  • Manage employee schedules and payroll; ensure timely reviews of time punches, meal break violations, and overtime compliance (adhering to seniority and the shift bid).

  • Recommend and initiate disciplinary, or other staffing/human resources-related actions in accordance with company rules and policies. Collaborate with the Director of Food & Beverage or Assistant Director of Food & Beverage of potentially serious issues.

  • Monitor and evaluate service quality through guest feedback, mystery shops, and internal audits.

  • Lead and participate in regular department and pre-shift meetings to ensure communication of priorities, promotions, and service expectations.

Financial Performance & Purchasing

  • Collaborate with the Director of Food & Beverage and Assistant Director of Food & Beverage with the development of departmental budgets, ensuring alignment with financial goals.

  • Control expenses and labor costs to maximize profitability across all venues.

  • Drive revenue growth through upselling, promotions, and exceptional guest service.

  • Conduct regular inventory in line with established procedures; implement and manage tracking systems (e.g., Micros, Avero).

  • Ensure all credit and financial transactions are handled in a secure manner.

  • Ensure the security and proper storage of food and beverage products, inventory and equipment, and replenish supplies in a timely and efficient manner while minimizing waste.

  • Maintain vendor and supplier relationships; negotiate pricing, streamline product launches, and resolve service issues.

  • Liaise with regulatory agencies and other external contacts as required.

QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Hotel Management, culinary arts, or related field preferred.

  • Must speak fluent English.

This job requires ability to perform the following:

  • Moving about the facilities

  • Carrying or lifting items weighing up to 50 pounds

  • Handling food, objects, products, and utensils

  • Bending, stooping, kneeling

Other:

  • Communication skills are utilized a significant amount of time when interacting with others; demonstrated ability to interact with guests, employees and third parties that reflects highly on the hotel, the brand and the Company

  • Reading and writing abilities are utilized often when completing paperwork and management reports, interpreting results, giving and receiving instructions, and training

  • Problem solving, reasoning, motivating, organizational and training abilities are used often

title: Snowflake Data Engineer
description:
About xCroTek

xCroTek is a product- and service-based AI software company that builds innovative, AI-powered solutions to drive intelligent automation and digital transformation. We specialize in creating scalable, impactful technologies for modern businesses.

Job Overview

We are seeking a talented Snowflake Data Engineer with 1–5 years of experience in building and managing modern data pipelines. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Snowpipe, Azure Data Factory (ADF), and hands‑on experience with batch, near real-time, real-time, and CDC (Change Data Capture) data processing. The role involves designing scalable, cost‑efficient, and high‑performing data solutions to support advanced analytics and reporting.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines on Snowflake using Azure Data Factory for orchestration.
  • Implement Snowpipe-based continuous data ingestion for near real-time use cases.
  • Build solutions supporting batch, near real-time, and real-time data processing.
  • Implement and optimize CDC (Change Data Capture) pipelines to ensure timely and accurate data updates.
  • Optimize Snowflake performance (warehouses, clustering, micro-partitions, caching).
  • Develop scalable data models (star, snowflake, normalized/denormalized) aligned with analytics needs.
  • Ensure data quality, lineage, and governance across pipelines.
  • Integrate data from diverse sources including APIs, databases, cloud storage, and streaming platforms.
  • Automate workflows and data orchestration using ADF pipelines, triggers, and event‑based executions.
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams (BI, Data Science, Product) to deliver reliable datasets.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize pipeline performance while ensuring cost efficiency.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
  • 1–5 years of experience as a Data Engineer, with at least 2+ years working on Snowflake.
  • Strong hands‑on expertise with Snowpipe for near real‑time ingestion.
  • Proven experience with Azure Data Factory (ADF) (pipelines, triggers, linked services).
  • Experience in batch, near real-time, and real-time data processing.
  • Hands‑on experience implementing CDC solutions (using tools like Debezium, Kafka, ADF, or other connectors).
  • Strong SQL skills for query tuning, optimization, and transformation logic.
  • Proficiency in Python or other scripting languages for data engineering and automation.
  • Knowledge of cloud storage services (Azure Blob, ADLS, or AWS S3).
  • Familiarity with RBAC, security, and compliance best practices in Snowflake.
  • Excellent problem‑solving, analytical, and communication skills.

title: Senior Director Global Regulatory Lead Devices & Regenerative Aesthetics
description:
About Hugel

Founded in 2001, Hugel is a South Korea–based global leader in medical aesthetics, specializing in the development and commercialization of botulinum toxin, hyaluronic acid fillers, skin boosters, threads, and biocosmetics. Over the past two decades, Hugel has built a strong global footprint, with commercial presence in approximately 70 countries and operations across nine international subsidiaries.

Leveraging strong global momentum, Hugel Aesthetics was formed as the Company's dedicated North American business unit, established to lead commercialization in the United States, Canada, and Australia. Backed by Hugel's global scale and expertise, Hugel Aesthetics is a well-resourced, growth-oriented organization focused on expanding access to Letybo and establishing a strong, long-term presence in medical aesthetics.


Company Culture

We are building our U.S. organization from the ground up, creating a culture that is intentionally different from traditional, highly layered companies. This is a rare opportunity to join at an early stage and help shape not only the business, but the way we work, lead, and grow together.

Our culture is rooted in high ownership, collaboration, and the belief that every voice matters. We value people who bring ideas, take initiative, and want a true seat at the table. In this environment, individuals are empowered to make an impact, move with agility, and help build what comes next.

Above all, we are deeply customer focused. We are committed to earning trust, building long-term partnerships, and delivering meaningful value through science, transparency, and integrity.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment, embraces ambiguity, and is energized by the opportunity to build, contribute, and grow alongside a team that is creating something special.


About This Role

The Senior Director, Global Regulatory Lead (GRL) — Devices & Regenerative Aesthetics will serve as the global regulatory strategic leader for Hugel's medical device portfolio, with emphasis on biostimulatory, regenerative medicine, tissue-related, combination/novel technology, and other innovative aesthetic products. You will develop, maintain, and execute integrated global regulatory strategies across the full product lifecycle — from early development and business development due diligence through registration, commercialization, and lifecycle management.

You will partner closely with R&D and cross-functional teams in the U.S., Korea, and additional global markets, with frequent travel to Korea to support pipeline programs and health authority preparation. This is a highly visible, enterprise-level role for someone who wants to represent Global Regulatory Affairs on cross-functional asset teams, engage directly with global health authorities and notified bodies, and bring clear, actionable recommendations to senior leadership and governance committees.


What You Will Do

Global Regulatory Strategy & Lifecycle Management

  • Serve as Global Regulatory Lead for assigned medical device, biostimulatory, regenerative medicine, tissue-related, and other aesthetic development programs, establishing regulatory pathways from early R&D through the full product lifecycle.
  • Develop and maintain an integrated global regulatory strategy across the U.S., Korea, Europe, Canada, Australia, Asia-Pacific, and other priority markets.
  • Identify regulatory opportunities, risks, and dependencies early enough to influence product development and enterprise decision-making.
  • Provide regulatory leadership for novel technologies where classification, jurisdiction, or development pathways are not well established.
  • Provide strategic oversight of major global submissions and lead resolution of significant deficiencies and health authority challenges.

Governance & Enterprise Decision-Making

  • Serve as the regulatory representative and strategic advisor on cross-functional asset teams and governance committees.
  • Translate complex health authority feedback into concise, executive-level recommendations, escalating significant risks with practical mitigation options.
  • Partner with senior leaders across R&D, Clinical, Medical, Safety, Quality, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Commercial, Legal, and Business Development.

R&D and Product Development Partnership

  • Serve as strategic regulatory partner to R&D teams in Korea and the U.S. from concept through commercialization, traveling frequently to Korea to support development planning and project reviews.
  • Provide regulatory guidance across the product lifecycle, including classification and pathway, claims, preclinical/clinical strategy, CMC, design controls, and global submission sequencing.

Global Health Authority & Notified Body Engagement

  • Lead face-to-face regulatory meetings and develop meeting strategy — objectives, anticipated agency positions, negotiation approach, and desired outcomes.
  • Lead or present directly during interactions with agencies such as the U.S. FDA, Korean MFDS, European authorities and notified bodies, Health Canada, and Australian TGA.
  • Translate health authority feedback into clear implications for strategy, timelines, and investment decisions.

Business Development & Due Diligence

  • Serve as senior regulatory expert for business development, licensing, acquisition, and partnership opportunities.
  • Independently evaluate regulatory opportunities and risks associated with potential assets and convert findings into executive-level risk assessments and recommendations.

Regulatory Intelligence & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Maintain strong awareness of evolving global regulatory requirements affecting medical devices and emerging aesthetic platforms.
  • Build strong relationships across geographically and culturally diverse teams, facilitating alignment between Korea, U.S., and regional regulatory organizations.


What We Are Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in a scientific, engineering, biomedical, regulatory, or related discipline; advanced degree preferred.
  • Typically 12+ years of progressively responsible regulatory affairs experience, with substantial experience in the medical device industry.
  • Significant experience leading regulatory strategy for aesthetic medical devices, preferably including injectables, implants, dermal fillers, biostimulatory products, regenerative medicine technologies, or tissue-related products.
  • Demonstrated experience functioning as a Global Regulatory Lead or equivalent strategic regulatory leader for development-stage and marketed products.
  • Extensive direct experience interacting with global health authorities and notified bodies, including leading and presenting during face-to-face regulatory meetings.
  • Proven and recent success obtaining regulatory approvals for medical devices in the global aesthetics market, with meaningful personal leadership of the strategy and approval process.
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. FDA medical device regulatory requirements and experience developing strategies for international markets.
  • Substantial regulatory due diligence experience, including evaluation of licensing, acquisition, partnership, or investment opportunities.
  • Fluency or professional proficiency in Korean is strongly preferred and would be a significant advantage.
  • Exceptional written, verbal, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, including frequent travel to Korea.

Compensation:

The most likely base pay range for this position is $235,000 to $265,000 per year. Several factors, such as experience, tenure, skills, and particular business needs, will determine an individual’s exact level of compensation. Base salary is only one element of employee compensation at Hugel Aesthetics. The total cash compensation could include base salary and incentive compensation.

Location

This is an on-site role based in Irvine, CA.

title: RN-CSS
description:
Behavioral Health Network (BHN) is a leading statewide provider of behavioral health services and a Certified Great Place to Work. Since 1938, BHN has helped individuals, families, and communities thrive through compassionate, high-quality care and support. With deep roots in Western Massachusetts and a growing presence in communities throughout the state, we are currently seeking a Registered Nurse to join our Clinical Stabilization Services (CSS) team and help advance our mission of empowering people to live healthier, more fulfilling lives.

What We Offer:

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Make a meaningful impact in the lives of individuals, families, and communities throughout Western Massachusetts.
  • Professional Growth – Access ongoing training, mentorship, career development, and advancement opportunities across one of the region's largest behavioral health organizations.
  • Supportive Team Culture – Join a collaborative workplace guided by our HEART values: Humanity, Empowerment, Accountability, Respect, and Teamwork.
  • Stability & Opportunity – Build your career with a well-established organization serving Western Massachusetts since 1938.
  • Comprehensive Benefits – Generous PTO, 403(b), educational assistance, medical, dental, vision, employee assistance programs, and more.
  • Certified Great Place to Work – Work for an organization recognized for creating a positive and engaging employee experience.

What You Will Do:

  • Provide compassionate, person-centered clinical and nursing services to individuals receiving treatment through BHN's Clinical Stabilization Services (CSS) program.
  • Complete comprehensive intake and ongoing nursing assessments, including review of systems, diagnoses, mental status, vital signs, withdrawal-related concerns, and emerging medical or behavioral-health needs.
  • Transcribe, verify, and administer medications as ordered; maintain accurate medication records; inventory medications; coordinate refills; and dispose of outdated or unused medications according to program policy.
  • Use nursing assessment and clinical judgment to determine and implement appropriate treatment or referral responses using the least restrictive alternative.
  • Consult regularly with the Nurse Manager, providers, pharmacies, emergency departments, program staff, significant others, and collateral partners to support treatment planning and continuity of care.
  • Provide individuals, groups, families, and staff with education about recovery, health, wellness, medical conditions, medications, and treatment effectiveness.
  • Build rapport and trust with individuals served while maintaining a safe, healthy, respectful, and recovery-oriented milieu with appropriate professional boundaries.
  • Triage referrals and nursing workflow during assigned shifts, participate in daily treatment-planning and disposition meetings, and respond effectively to changing or urgent clinical needs.
  • Complete nursing assessments, progress notes, medication orders, discharge summaries, and other required documentation clearly, accurately, and on time.
  • Facilitate transfers, aftercare planning, and discharge to the next appropriate level of care; maintain required licensure and continuing education; and perform other duties as assigned.

Who You Are:

  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • Current, unrestricted Massachusetts Registered Nurse license required.
  • At least one year of experience or training working in behavioral health and one year of post-graduate medical-surgical nursing experience required.
  • Basic understanding of behavioral-health conditions, recovery principles, co-occurring needs, and appropriate pharmaceutical, medical, and psychoeducational interventions required.
  • Ability to complete comprehensive nursing assessments, identify medical and psychiatric needs, administer medications safely, and coordinate appropriate treatment and referrals.
  • Ability to provide high-quality stabilization care and educate individuals about recovery, health, wellness, medications, and strategies that support continued progress.
  • Strong clinical judgment, critical thinking, problem-solving, adaptability, organization, time-management, and prioritization skills, including the ability to respond effectively to urgent needs.
  • Demonstrated cultural responsiveness and ability to establish rapport and work respectfully with individuals from diverse backgrounds and with complex needs.
  • Excellent interpersonal, teamwork, technology, and verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to maintain timely and accurate electronic documentation.
  • Ability to serve as essential staff and meet the physical requirements of the role, including regular standing, walking, and sitting and lifting or carrying up to 25 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.

We Hire for HEART!

Since 1938, BHN has delivered high-quality, culturally responsive behavioral health care, building deep roots in Western Massachusetts while expanding our impact in communities throughout the state. Our core values—Humanity, Empowerment, Accountability, Respect, and Teamwork—guide how we lead, serve, and support one another. If you’re ready to bring your skills and experience to a mission-driven organization where your work can make a meaningful difference, we’d love to hear from you.

As one of three comprehensive portfolios at Medtronic, Neuroscience is dedicated to improving the lives of people living with neurological disorders, spine conditions, and chronic pain. Guided by our Mission—to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life—we develop technologies and therapies that help people regain function, reduce pain, and return to the activities that matter most.

Our Neurovascular Operating Unit develops and delivers advanced, minimally invasive endovascular technologies for the treatment of acute ischemic and hemorrhagic stroke, brain aneurysms, and other complex cerebrovascular conditions. Through catheters, stent retrievers, flow diversion, and embolization systems, these solutions enable rapid, image-guided interventions that restore blood flow, secure vessels, and support consistent performance in high-acuity neurovascular procedures.

Check us out on LinkedIn: Medtronic Neurovascular

Hands-on Research & Design Engineer who turns experimental data into design, clinical strategy, and external technical narratives to advance early-stage programs from pre-clinical validation through early clinical readiness. Electro-mechanical design, execution, and analysis of pre-clinical and cadaveric studies; translates experimental data into engineering requirements (device architecture, electrode configuration, procedural workflow) to advance therapy development.

Applies strong engineering fundamentals and data analysis (signal interpretation, modeling, statistical comparison across studies) to drive decisions on feasibility, performance, and design tradeoffs.

At Medtronic, we bring bold ideas forward with speed and decisiveness to put patients first in everything we do. In-person exchanges are invaluable to our work. We’re working a minimum of 4 days a week onsite as part of our commitment to fostering a culture of professional growth and cross-functional collaboration as we work together to engineer the extraordinary.

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.

  • Translate experimental data into engineering requirements to advance therapy development.

  • Design and execute pre-clinical/cadaveric studies with integrated electro-mechanical systems.

  • Apply quantitative analysis (signal, modeling, statistics) to drive feasibility, performance, and design decisions.

  • Serve as R&T engineering interface supporting cross-functional clinical and regulatory strategies (EFS, IDE, Breakthrough).

  • Distill complex data into clear technical narratives and contribute to publications and external presentations.

  • Hands-on product development support to advance R&T concepts and therapies into and through New Product Development.

Required Knowledge and Experience:

  • Requires a Baccalaureate degree and

  • Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with neurovascular/endovascular systems (catheters, delivery systems, image-guided procedures)

  • Neural and electrophysiology (EP) signal acquisition, processing, and interpretation

  • Hands-on experience with pre-clinical or cadaveric studies in neuro or cardiovascular systems

  • Electro-mechanical design experience in implantable or catheter-based devices

  • Ability to translate experimental data into system architecture and therapy strategy (e.g., stimulation targets, electrode design, workflow)

  • Experience supporting early clinical/regulatory pathways (EFS, IDE, Breakthrough, Collaborative Research)

For Baccalaureate degrees earned outside of the United States, a degree that satisfies the requirements of 8 C.F.R. § 214.2(h)(4)(iii)(A) is required.

title: Senior Director-Philanthropy
description:
Job Description:

Job Title: Senior Director of Philanthropy

Location: Saint Louis, Missouri

Department: FDN

Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary:

Are you a strategic fundraising leader passionate about transforming lives through philanthropy? Join our compassionate, collaborative team as a Senior Director of Philanthropy and help advance a mission dedicated to improving the health and wellbeing of individuals and communities. This is an exciting opportunity to lead regional fundraising efforts, build meaningful relationships with generous supporters, inspire a high-performing team, influence organizational growth, and make a lasting impact through mission-driven work. We are seeking a relationship-focused, results-oriented leader with exceptional communication skills, strategic vision, and a passion for connecting donor generosity with meaningful outcomes.

The Senior Director of Philanthropy serves as the primary fundraising leader for the assigned region and is responsible for advancing organizational priorities through strategic philanthropy, donor engagement, and team leadership. This role oversees all aspects of regional fundraising, including major gifts, corporate and foundation partnerships, annual giving initiatives, donor stewardship, campaigns, and special events. The Senior Director manages a portfolio of major donors and prospects while partnering closely with executives, program leaders, board members, and Foundation colleagues to identify funding opportunities, develop philanthropic strategies, and foster a culture of giving throughout the organization.

Saint Louis offers a vibrant blend of culture, history, affordability, and community spirit. With world-class attractions, thriving neighborhoods, outstanding parks, and a strong philanthropic community, Saint Louis provides an excellent environment for professionals seeking meaningful work while enjoying a high quality of life.

This position offers…

· Employee Assistance Program – 24/7 counseling services, legal assistance, & financial consultation for you and your household at no cost

· Mileage Reimbursement – Company paid for work functions requiring travel

· Employee Discounts – Hotels, Theme Parks & Attractions, College Tuition

· Workplace Culture - An environment cultivating employee wellbeing, valuing each individual's humanity, and actively promoting a healthy, joyful workforce

· Additional Perks & Benefits - Scroll down to bottom of this post to learn more

Key Responsibilities:

· Lead and execute a comprehensive regional fundraising strategy that supports organizational priorities and fundraising goals exceeding $1 million annually

· Cultivate, solicit, secure, and steward major gifts from individual, corporate, and foundation donors with giving capacity of $20,000 or more

· Build and manage a portfolio of approximately 75-100 donors and prospects while developing personalized engagement strategies for each relationship

· Partner with regional executives, program leaders, board members, and community advocates to identify funding priorities and create compelling opportunities for philanthropic investment

· Develop and implement annual fundraising plans that include major gifts, annual giving efforts, corporate sponsorships, campaigns, and special events

· Lead, coach, and support regional fundraising staff, fostering professional growth and accountability for portfolio and revenue performance

· Leverage community relationships and strategic partnerships to expand donor pipelines and increase philanthropic support

· Collaborate with communications and marketing teams to share impactful donor stories and strengthen fundraising messaging

· Coordinate planned giving initiatives in partnership with Foundation leadership and legal counsel

· Ensure meaningful donor recognition, stewardship, reporting, and engagement activities that strengthen long-term relationships

· Prepare and oversee fundraising proposals, donor communications, presentations, and stewardship materials

· Manage regional fundraising budgets and monitor progress toward fundraising objectives

· Maintain accurate donor records, prospect activity, and fundraising data within the CRM system

· Contribute to organizational reporting, business reviews, campaign planning, and board presentations

· Uphold ethical fundraising standards and maintain confidentiality of donor information

Education, Experience, and/or Credential Qualifications:

· Bachelor’s degree required

· Minimum of seven (7) years of progressive fundraising experience in a nonprofit or healthcare environment

· Demonstrated success cultivating, soliciting, and securing major gifts

· Experience managing comprehensive fundraising programs, including major gifts, annual giving, corporate giving, foundation relations, campaigns, and donor stewardship

· Prior experience supervising, mentoring, or leading development professionals

· Experience with donor database and CRM management

· Experience with planned giving, annual giving, and/or capital campaigns preferred

Additional Qualifications:

· Strong knowledge of fundraising principles, donor lifecycle strategies, and moves management practices

· Exceptional communication, interpersonal, presentation, and relationship-building skills

· Ability to engage effectively with executives, board members, community leaders, and high-net-worth individuals

· Skilled at translating programmatic needs into compelling donor-centered messaging and funding opportunities

· Strategic, proactive, and highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously

· Strong attention to detail and commitment to donor confidentiality and data accuracy

· Passion for behavioral health, health equity, and mission-driven work

· Valid driver's license, acceptable driving record, and proof of insurance required

· Ability to travel throughout the assigned region and occasionally out of state

Physical Requirements

· Work may be performed in office, clinical, residential, and community-based environments depending on assignment

· Frequently use computers, office equipment, and electronic systems

· Prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, and computer work may be required

· May occasionally work evenings, weekends, holidays, or extended hours to support fundraising events, donor engagement activities, and organizational needs

· Perform sedentary work involving exertion of up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and negligible force frequently to move objects

· Ability to travel regularly within the assigned region and occasionally outside the region

· Reasonable accommodations may be provided to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position





Position Perks & Benefits:

Paid time off: full-time employees receive an attractive time off package to balance your work and personal life

Employee benefits package: full-time employees receive health, dental, vision, retirement, life, & more

Top-notch training: initial, ongoing, comprehensive, and supportive

Career mobility: advancement opportunities/promoting from within

Welcoming, warm, supportive: a work culture & environment that promotes your well-being, values you as human being, and encourages your health and happiness.





Brightli is on a Mission:

A mission to improve client care, reduce the financial burden of community mental health centers by sharing resources, a mission to have a larger voice in advocacy to increase access to mental health and substance user care in our communities, and a mission to evolve the behavioral health industry to better meet the needs of our clients.

As a behavioral and community mental health provider, we prioritize fostering a culture of belonging and connection within our workforce. We encourage applications from individuals with varied backgrounds and experiences, as we believe that a rich tapestry of perspectives strengthens our mission. If you are passionate about empowering local communities and creating an environment where everyone feels valued and supported, we invite you to join our mission-driven organization dedicated to cultivating an authentic workplace.

We are an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.

Burrell Behavioral Health is a Smoke and Tobacco Free Workplace.

description:

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon.
