  • Independently design and ship features in your secondary stack that involve multi-step business logic (branching tied to domain rules) — not just CRUD or pass-through data.

  • Write automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests on both sides of any code you own or modify.
  • Participate in code review on both frontend and backend PRs, flagging cross-boundary issues even outside your primary stack.
  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and specialist engineers on both teams to scope and deliver features that span the BFF layer.
  • Instrument and monitor code you own for observability (e.g., Prometheus metrics on backend services).

Qualifications

Golang — RESTful APIs, MongoDB, NATS (or equivalent message queue), automated testing

  • Working competence in the other stack: able to independently ship features with multi-step business logic (branching tied to domain rules), not just CRUD.
  • Demonstrated experience directing AI coding agents on real production code — prompting for a specific output, reviewing and correcting generated code, and judging when the agent's output isn't good enough to merge.
  • Strong Git and agile workflow experience.

Preferred:

  • OCPI protocol ( or similar domain-specific API standard experience.

We offer

  • US and EU projects based on advanced technologies.
  • Competitive compensation based on skills and experience.
  • Regular performance appraisals to support your growth.

  • Personalized learning program tailored to your interests and skill development.
  • Free tech webinars and meetups organized by Svitla.

Svitla Systems is a global digital solutions company headquartered in the U.S. and operating across the Americas, Europe, Asia, and APAC. Since 2003, we have served a wide range of clients - from innovative start-ups to Fortune 500 companies. Our success is built on partnership. Our global mission is to build a business that contributes to wellbeing of our partners, personnel, and their families, improves our communities, and makes a lasting difference in the world. Together, we are coding a brighter tomorrow - and living it.

title: Senior Principal Systems Development Engineer
description:
Senior Principal System Development Engineer

Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG) builds the products that power infrastructure, solutions, and data management our customers need
most. Our teams design and develop the hardware and software that connect infrastructure, accelerate computational workloads, integrate
across the stack, protect data continuity, and deliver the platforms, applications, and diagnostics our customers rely on every day at enterprise
scale. ​

Some product builders follow the rules. Ours rewrite them.​

Within ISG, innovation isn't just about creating new technology- it's about challenging assumptions and reimagining how work gets done.
Engineers define intent, author precise specifications, and orchestrate AI agents that execute at speed and scale. AI is embedded throughout
our development process, helping us move faster, learn quicker, and deliver greater impact. Yet the most important contribution remains
uniquely human: deciding what to build, designing how it should work, and applying the judgment needed to earn our customers' trust. When
your products power critical infrastructure around the world, that responsibility matters.​

We move quickly toward the work that matters most. We reward experimentation, encourage bold thinking, and remove unnecessary barriers
so great ideas can become reality faster. Our teams embrace a customer-first, first-to-market mindset, transforming rapid feedback into better
products and better outcomes. We aren't looking for people who are content with the status quo- we look for builders who question it, improve
it, and occasionally rewrite it.​

If you're energized by solving complex systems challenges, excited to work alongside AI to amplify your impact, and motivated by the
opportunity to shape what's next instead of simply maintaining what's been done before, you'll find your place here.​

Join us and help build the future of enterprise technology. ​

What you’ll achieve:

As a Senior Principal System Development Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and implementing the Diags, ONIE, BIOS, BMC and FW based on the customer’s business goals, needs and general business environment creating software solutions on Networking Switch products.

Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as a Senior Principal System Development Engineer on our Systems Engineering Dev team in Round Rock, Texas. or Santa Clara,California.

You will:

•Contribute to the design and architecture of high-quality, complex systems and software/networking environments
•Prepare, review and evaluate the Diags, ONIE, BMC and BIOS design specifications for networking switch products and systems
•Contribute to the development and implementation of test strategies on Diags, ONIE, BMC and BIOS for networking switch products and systems

title: Leasing Professional- The Smith
description:
ABOUT GREYSTAR


Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit .

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

This position is responsible for coordinating the community’s marketing, leasing, and renewal strategies to achieve occupancy, revenue, and resident retention goals by performing all activities related to leasing to new residents, providing resident satisfaction throughout the term of the lease, and securing resident lease renewals.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Essential Responsibilities:
• Performs all sales and leasing activities to achieve the community’s revenue and occupancy goals by greeting and qualifying prospects, conducting community tours and showing apartments, processing applications, credit screening, and criminal background checks, preparing the lease and move-in package, and ensuring a smooth resident move-in and lease signing.
• Inspects apartments prior to resident move-in and ensures apartments are in move-in ready condition and schedules any outstanding item to be addressed with the maintenance team.
• Stays informed about current market and competitor conditions that may impact the community’s occupancy and sales results, develops and implements short- and long-term marketing plans and goals to sustain occupancy, and follows the community’s established policies related to concessions, specials, and other programs to boost occupancy.
• Designs and executes marketing activities to create and drive traffic to the community, including implementing resident referral and employer outreach programs, using internet marketing tools (Craigslist, Facebook, e-mail, and other websites), and following other community-specific marketing plans, drives, and special programs.
• Uses the on-site property management software (OneSite, Yardi, etc.) to track apartment availability, record traffic and leasing activities, manage resident and prospect data, and capture critical demographic and other information about existing and future residents.
• Ensures that the community and show units meet the Company’s standards for show quality by daily inspecting the marketing corridor and leasing tour, communicating maintenance and upkeep needs to the community’s maintenance team members, merchandising and ensuring a physically appealing show unit and/or model and amenities, and preparing the leasing office for daily leasing activities.
• Follows-up with prospects and new residents to ensure satisfaction by sending e-mail, thank-you notes, and cards or making telephone calls or other contacts to finalize decisions to lease and/or renew.
• Executes and performs activities in support of the community’s lease renewal program by preparing lease renewal letters and packages for residents, meeting with and contacting renewing residents in advance of move-out dates, and ensuring that lease renewal documents are signed and implemented on time.
• Responds quickly and courteously to resident and client/owner concerns and questions, and takes prompt action to solve problems and/or document and convey resident or other requests to the appropriate individual(s).

Required Licenses or Certifications:
• Incumbents must have all licenses and/or certifications as required by State and Local jurisdictions

• Incumbents must have valid driver’s license to operate a golf cart on property.

Physical Demands:

  • Incumbents need to be able to stand, walk, and/or sit for extended periods of time and bend, stoop, climb ladders, reach, carry objects, and crawl in confined areas.
  • Incumbents must be able to work inside and outside in all weather conditions (rain, snow, heat, hail, wind, sleet).
  • Incumbents must be able to push, pull, lift, carry, or maneuver weights of up to twenty-five (25) pounds independently and fifty (50) pounds with assistance.
  • Rare or regular travel may be required to assist other properties as needed, attend training classes, business meetings, or other situations necessary for the accomplishment of some or all of the daily responsibilities of this position.

title: Applied Psychology Benchmark Specialist
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking expert psychologists to author and review high-quality academic assessment content for an AI research initiative. You will write and verify rigorous multiple-choice questions across core psychology domains, evaluate solution quality, and help establish gold-standard benchmarks used to advance AI capabilities.

You will be assigned one of two task types:

  • Question Authoring — Create original, challenging multiple-choice questions in your area of psychology expertise, rate their difficulty, and submit them for review.

  • Question Verification — Review pre-written questions for accuracy, clarity, and rigor. Edit where needed, rate difficulty, and document any changes made.

Psychology Domains Covered

Neuromorphic Engineering, Human Factors and Engineering Psychology, Consumer and Market Psychology, Psychometrics, Digital Health, Psychedelic-assisted Therapy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Author original psychology questions that test deep conceptual understanding, not surface-level recall

  • Ensure questions are unambiguous, self-contained, and precisely defined — all necessary information must be in the problem statement

  • Rate each question’s difficulty: Medium (intro undergraduate), Hard (advanced undergraduate), or Expert (post-graduate and above)

  • Provide 1 correct answer and 9 plausible but subtly incorrect alternatives that challenge expert-level solvers

  • Write step-by-step Chain-of-Thought solutions with clear, concise reasoning in markdown format

  • Supply 1–5 academic references per question from reputable sources (peer-reviewed journals, university repositories)

  • For verification tasks: flag issues with clarity, completeness, precision, or solvability and justify any edits made

Ideal Qualifications

  • PhD, PsyD, or doctoral candidate in Psychology or a closely related field

  • Master’s degree considered for candidates with exceptional depth in a specific subdomain

  • Strong command of graduate-level psychological theory, research methodology, and empirical literature

  • Clinical licensure or research publications in psychology is a strong plus

  • Excellent written English and ability to express complex ideas clearly and concisely

More About the Opportunity

  • Expected commitment: 10+ hours/week

  • Asynchronous, fully remote work

title: Senior Software Engineer – AI/HPC Middleware
description:
At Cornelis we’re building the future of AI and HPC networking with an AI-first approach to silicon and software development. We’re seeking engineers who are energized by working on cutting-edge ASIC design and distributed software systems, and who are motivated to push the boundaries on how AI can transform everything from chip architecture to system performance at scale.


Cornelis Networks delivers the world’s highest performance scale-out networking solutions for AI and HPC datacenters. Our differentiated architecture seamlessly integrates hardware, software and system level technologies to maximize the efficiency of GPU, CPU and accelerator-based compute clusters at any scale. Our solutions drive breakthroughs in AI & HPC workloads, empowering our customers to push the boundaries of innovation. Backed by top-tier venture capital and strategic investors, we are committed to innovation, performance and scalability - solving the world’s most demanding computational challenges with our next-generation networking solutions.


We are a fast-growing, forward-thinking team of architects, engineers, and business professionals with a proven track record of building successful products and companies. As a global organization, our team spans multiple U.S. states and six countries, and we continue to expand with exceptional talent in onsite, hybrid, and fully remote roles.


We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to contribute to the design, development, and upstream enablement of Cornelis Networks' AI/HPC communication middleware. This role focuses on enabling and optimizing HPC middleware (MPI/SHMEM) and AI middleware (collective communication libraries / CCL, e.g., NCCL/RCCL and related stacks) over Cornelis Networks' interconnects. You will help drive performance, correctness, and deployability across real customer workloads by collaborating across the stack (drivers/kernel, switches, systems, and application/framework teams) and by contributing upstream to key open-source projects.


Key Responsibilities

  • AI/HPC Middleware Enablement & Optimization: Implement and help optimize features for HPC middleware (HPI and SHMEM) and AI middleware (CCL stacks ie: NCCL/RCCL and related collective communication libraries)
  • Transport & Integration: Assist in integrating middleware capabilities with underlying transports and provider layers (ie: libfabric / OFI, UCX, verbs-like semantics where applicable)
  • Upstream & Open-Source Leadership: Prepare and submit upstream contributions across MPI/SHMEM projects, CCL ecosystems, and related components
  • Cross-Stack Collaboration & Performance Validation: Collaborate with kernel/driver and switch teams to help deliver end-to-end performance aligned to the Cornelis product roadmap
  • Customer & Field Impact: Help analyze performance traces and reproduce customer issues, and assist in translating findings into fixes.


Minimum Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in systems programming in C/C++ on Linux; Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience). Master's or Doctorate a plus.
  • Hands-on experience with HPC middleware internals (Open MPI, MPICH, MVAPICH, and/or SHMEM) or optimizing collective communications for AI, including NCCL/RCCL, CUDA/ROCm) and/or other CCL stacks.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver low-latency/high-throughput communication paths and to diagnose performance issues using profiling/tracing tools.
  • Working knowledge of transport/integration layers such as OFI/libfabric, UCX, verbs-style concepts.
  • Solid background in RDMA concepts and performance tuning.
  • Experience contributing to open-source projects.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience developing or maintaining libfabric providers.
  • Familiarity with Ultra Ethernet (UEC/UET) specifications.
  • Experience with RoCEv2, congestion control, and/or Ethernet-based RDMA deployments.
  • Experience with cluster-scale benchmarking, profiling, and optimization.
  • Background with HPC fabrics, such as Omni-Path.


Location:

This role may work remote from Costa Rica via an EOR (Employer of Record).


We offer a competitive compensation package that includes base salary, performance incentives and equity participation.


At Cornelis Networks, your compensation is only one component of your comprehensive total rewards package. Compensation will be determined by factors such as experience, qualifications, skills, and location relative to the hiring range for the position.


Depending on your geographic location, in addition to your total rewards package, you may also be eligible for additional benefits, paid holidays, and flexible work arrangements.

title: Associate Program Manager, HR
description:
About the role

Rippling is seeking a highly organized, operationally rigorous Associate Program Manager, HR to help drive critical HR programs and cross-functional initiatives that improve the support of Rippling’s continued scale and HR execution.


This role will report to the VP of HR and serve as a core operator across several high-impact and varied work streams, including new hire onboarding, benefits, HR PMO projects, AI-enabled HR initiatives, OKRs/QBRs, M&A readiness and integration work, IPO-related HR projects, and Rippling Rituals.


The ideal candidate is a strong program manager and operator who can create structure in ambiguity, drive stakeholders to decisions, translate complex work into clear plans, and ensure execution does not stall. You are comfortable operating across strategic HR priorities and tactical details. You can support executive-level work streams while also rolling up your sleeves to improve processes, manage dashboards & tooling, track issues & analytics, prepare materials, and ensure project completion.


This is a high-impact role for someone who brings judgment, discretion, analytical orientation, and an incredible bias for getting sh!t done!

What you will do

  • Lead and operationalize HR programs and projects from intake through execution, ensuring clear scope, owners, milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions, and success measures.
  • Own Rippling’s global new hire onboarding program to deliver a consistent, high-quality onboarding experience, ensuring seamless coordination with regional onboarding hubs.
  • Support benefits-related programs and operational improvements, including employee education, partnering with product to ensure issue resolution, stakeholder coordination, communications, process documentation, and cross-functional execution.
  • Serve as a PMO partner to the VP of HR across priority initiatives, including AI in HR, OKRs/QBRs, M&A readiness and integration, IPO readiness, Rippling Rituals, Rippling product feedback, and other HR work streams.
  • Build and manage project plans, trackers, dashboards, executive updates, decision documents, and enablement material that create clarity, accountability, and momentum.
  • Identify opportunities to improve HR processes through automation, better data, clearer ownership, and stronger operating discipline.
  • Anticipate risks and dependencies, surface issues early, and drive resolution without waiting for perfect direction.
  • Maintain strong documentation, project hygiene, and communication loops so stakeholders know what is happening, what is needed, and who owns next steps.
  • Handle confidential HR, employee, business, and executive information with discretion, sound judgment, and appropriate care.

What you will need

  • 3+ years of experience in program management, project management, people operations, HR operations, consulting, business operations, or HR-related project delivery.
  • Strong program and project management fundamentals, including scoping, planning, governance, milestone tracking, risk management, stakeholder management, and execution.
  • Experience supporting complex, cross-functional initiatives in fast-moving, high-growth environments.
  • Comfort working across HR domains such as onboarding, benefits, HR operations, and internal communications.
  • Strong analytical/technical skills and the ability to use AI, data, dashboards, and issue trackers to identify themes, monitor progress, and drive action.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to facilitate meetings/presentations and synthesize complex information into clear updates with practical recommendations.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to build trust across a variety of partners and leaders
  • High judgment and discretion when handling confidential employee, HR, business, and executive-level information.
  • Strong attention to detail, follow-through, and ownership; you close loops and make sure work does not drift.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities; you clarify the goal, build the plan, align the right stakeholders, and keep execution moving.
  • Low-ego, hands-on operating style with a bias for action and a willingness to jump in wherever needed.

What makes you successful

  • You can operate at multiple altitudes: understanding the strategic intent behind HR priorities while managing the details required to execute well.
  • You bring structure to ambiguous work and help leaders make faster, better decisions.
  • You are proactive about risks, dependencies, and stakeholder alignment.
  • You communicate crisply and know how to make complex work easy for executives and cross-functional partners to understand.
  • You improve the operating system around you — better dashboards, clearer owners, stronger cadences, tighter follow-through, and more scalable processes.
  • You care deeply about employee experience, but you pair that with operational discipline and business judgment.
  • You have a deep passion for AI, automations, and a self-service culture.

description:
ABOUT GREYSTAR


Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

This position is responsible for coordinating the community’s marketing, leasing, and renewal strategies to achieve occupancy, revenue, and resident retention goals by performing all activities related to leasing to new residents, providing resident satisfaction throughout the term of the lease, and securing resident lease renewals.

Property Type: Stabilized, Garden Style

Unit Count: 450

Schedule: Thursday - Monday

Requirements: 1-2 Years

Housing Discount - This position is eligible for 20% housing discount.

Position eligible for incentive-based bonuses.

The ideal candidate should have reliable transportation and experience supporting resident events, leasing activities, and setting up mini models or model units.

Essential Responsibilities:
• Performs all sales and leasing activities to achieve the community’s revenue and occupancy goals by greeting and qualifying prospects, conducting community tours and showing apartments, processing applications, credit screening, and criminal background checks, preparing the lease and move-in package, and ensuring a smooth resident move-in and lease signing.
• Inspects apartments prior to resident move-in and ensures apartments are in move-in ready condition and schedules any outstanding item to be addressed with the maintenance team.
• Stays informed about current market and competitor conditions that may impact the community’s occupancy and sales results, develops and implements short- and long-term marketing plans and goals to sustain occupancy, and follows the community’s established policies related to concessions, specials, and other programs to boost occupancy.
• Designs and executes marketing activities to create and drive traffic to the community, including implementing resident referral and employer outreach programs, using internet marketing tools (Craigslist, Facebook, e-mail, and other websites), and following other community-specific marketing plans, drives, and special programs.
• Uses the on-site property management software (OneSite, Yardi, etc.) to track apartment availability, record traffic and leasing activities, manage resident and prospect data, and capture critical demographic and other information about existing and future residents.
• Ensures that the community and show units meet the Company’s standards for show quality by daily inspecting the marketing corridor and leasing tour, communicating maintenance and upkeep needs to the community’s maintenance team members, merchandising and ensuring a physically appealing show unit and/or model and amenities, and preparing the leasing office for daily leasing activities.
• Follows-up with prospects and new residents to ensure satisfaction by sending e-mail, thank-you notes, and cards or making telephone calls or other contacts to finalize decisions to lease and/or renew.
• Executes and performs activities in support of the community’s lease renewal program by preparing lease renewal letters and packages for residents, meeting with and contacting renewing residents in advance of move-out dates, and ensuring that lease renewal documents are signed and implemented on time.
• Responds quickly and courteously to resident and client/owner concerns and questions, and takes prompt action to solve problems and/or document and convey resident or other requests to the appropriate individual(s).

Required Licenses or Certifications:
• Incumbents must have all licenses and/or certifications as required by State and Local jurisdictions

• Incumbents must have valid driver’s license to operate a golf cart on property.

Physical Demands:

  • Incumbents need to be able to stand, walk, and/or sit for extended periods of time and bend, stoop, climb ladders, reach, carry objects, and crawl in confined areas.
  • Incumbents must be able to work inside and outside in all weather conditions (rain, snow, heat, hail, wind, sleet).
  • Incumbents must be able to push, pull, lift, carry, or maneuver weights of up to twenty-five (25) pounds independently and fifty (50) pounds with assistance.

Our Enterprise Operations & Risk offering enables clients to achieve profitable growth and competitive advantage by optimizing "heart of the business" operations. title: Applied Health & Medicine Benchmark Specialist
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking expert medical and health science professionals to author and review high-quality academic assessment content for an AI research initiative. You will write and verify rigorous multiple-choice questions across core health and medicine domains, evaluate solution quality, and help establish gold-standard benchmarks used to advance AI capabilities.

You will be assigned one of two task types:

  • Question Authoring — Create original, challenging multiple-choice questions in your area of medical expertise, rate their difficulty, and submit them for review.

  • Question Verification — Review pre-written questions for accuracy, clarity, and rigor. Edit where needed, rate difficulty, and document any changes made.

Health & Medicine Domains Covered

Clinical Medicine & Surgery, Medical Imaging & Diagnostics, Pharmacovigilance, Healthcare Management & Economics, Rehabilitation and Allied Health.

Key Responsibilities

  • Author original health and medicine questions that test deep conceptual understanding, not surface-level recall

  • Ensure questions are unambiguous, self-contained, and precisely defined — all necessary information must be in the problem statement

  • Rate each question’s difficulty: Medium (intro undergraduate), Hard (advanced undergraduate), or Expert (post-graduate and above)

  • Provide 1 correct answer and 9 plausible but subtly incorrect alternatives that challenge expert-level solvers

  • Write step-by-step Chain-of-Thought solutions with clear, concise reasoning in markdown format

  • Supply 1–5 academic references per question from reputable sources (peer-reviewed journals, clinical guidelines)

  • For verification tasks: flag issues with clarity, completeness, precision, or solvability and justify any edits made

Ideal Qualifications

  • MD, DO, PhD, or doctoral candidate in Medicine, Biomedical Sciences, Public Health, or a closely related field

  • Master’s degree considered for candidates with exceptional depth in a specific subdomain

  • Strong command of graduate-level medical knowledge, clinical reasoning, and biomedical research methodology

  • Board certification, clinical experience, or research publications in health fields is a strong plus

  • Excellent written English and ability to express complex ideas clearly and concisely

More About the Opportunity

  • Expected commitment: 10+ hours/week

  • Asynchronous, fully remote work

description:
Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.


Labcorp is a global leader in diagnostic testing and drug development solutions, helping healthcare providers, researchers, and patients make informed decisions that advance care. Join us in our mission to improve health and improve lives.

PAML a Labcorp company is seeking a Specimen Processor to join our team in the Spokane, WA

Work Schedule: Monday - Friday 6:00 pm to 2:30 am overtime and rotating weekends may be required

Job Responsibilities:

  • Introduce and prepare biological specimens to the laboratory to ensure accurate processing

  • Open specimens and pour off into secondary containers to prepare for analysis and testing

  • Verify patient demographic information matches the test requisition form submitted

  • Data entry of patient information into the computer system for tracking purposes

  • Meet key production metrics and quality measures to ensure timely and accurate results

  • Unpack and route specimens to their respective staging areas

  • Pack and ship specimens to proper testing facilities when required

  • Properly prepare and store excess specimen samples

  • Resolve and document any problem specimens

  • Handle and dispose of medical and chemical waste

  • Comply with applicable environmental health and safety policies and procedures

  • Operate automated instrumentation under supervision if necessary

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or GED or equivalent

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 6 Months or more medical office or hospital patient data entry experience

  • 6 months or more experience with specimen processing

Additional Job Standards:

  • Proficient computer and typing skills

  • Able to pass a standardized color blindness test

  • Comfortable handling human biological specimens including blood, urine and tissue samples

  • Ability to lift up to 30lbs, work in protective equipment and sit/stand for long periods of time

  • Strong eye hand coordination in order to accurately identify specimens by touch and sight

  • Ability to work both independently and in a team environment

  • Flexibility to work overtime as needed

  • Exceptional customer service

  • Strong communication skills; both written and verbal

  • Ability to work independently or in a team environment

  • Comfortable working under minimal supervision

Are you organized, accountable, and have always gone the extra mile to make sure things are done right? Imagine the impact those skills can have in ensuring the accuracy of millions of healthcare tests, every month. If you share our passion for strengthening physician care, please apply for the Specimen Processor position!

The Specimen Processor will be responsible for performing specimen accessioning, sample sorting and data entry in a fast-paced, high-throughput environment according to established standard operating procedures.

Pay Range: $17.75 to 25.20 per hour

Plus 2nd Shift Differential

All job offers will be based on a candidate’s skills and prior relevant experience, applicable degrees/certifications, as well as internal equity and market data.

title: CRM Automation & Personalisation Specialist (Sydney, Melbourne or Brisbane)
description:
CRM AUTOMATION & PERSONALISATION SPECIALIST (SYDNEY, MELBOURNE OR BRISBANE)

JMC Academy is seeking a CRM Automation & Personalisation Specialist to lead the build, optimisation and ongoing evolution of its CRM and lifecycle marketing capability. This is a hands-on specialist role for someone who can translate prospect and student data into well-structured automated journeys, targeted communications and measurable improvements in enquiry, application, offer and enrolment performance.

The role sits at the intersection of CRM operations, marketing automation, personalisation, data quality and journey optimisation, and will play an important role in the continued maturity of JMC’s student lifecycle communications and CRM environment.

About JMC Academy

Founded in 1982, JMC Academy is Australia’s premier institution in Creative Industries education, offering a diverse range of Degrees and Diplomas in Music, Songwriting, Audio Engineering, Film and Television Production, Acting, Entertainment Business Management, Visual Communication (Design), Animation, Game Design, and Music Production. With a 40-year legacy, JMC Academy provides cutting-edge and technologically advanced programs that meet the global demands of the creative industries. JMC operates from 3 large footprint campuses across the east coast of Australia (VIC, NSW & QLD), teaches ~2,500 students per annum and is positioned as one of the largest private higher education providers in Australia.

With advanced-design campuses, ongoing technology upgrades, a dedicated team of academics and industry professionals, and a network of international master class lecturers, JMC Academy is committed to ensuring our graduates make their own indelible mark on industry.

JMC Academy’s ultimate focus is to deliver inspiring and technologically sophisticated programs, which cater to the global needs of the Creative industries. By nurturing, supporting and mentoring students who share a true passion and dedication for these industries, we can guide them into rewarding careers.

Our Purpose

We educate and inspire creative minds to shape their careers and our world.

At JMC Academy, we educate and empower creative minds to transform their passion into lifelong careers and meaningful contributions to the world.

As a vibrant, inclusive community of innovators and explorers, we deliver rigorous, real-world education in the creative industries, uniting academic excellence with practical experience, emerging technologies and industry engagement.

We nurture resilience, compassion, and curiosity in every student, helping them chart their unique path, shape their careers, and become creative leaders who inspire, connect, and thrive, locally and globally.

Our Vision

To be the global leader in creative education, chosen by creatives, trusted by industry.

Our Values

  • Creative Innovators — An opportunity to dream, bring our creative genius to life, making meaningful contribution and delivering innovation to the world stage.
  • Curious & Resilient Explorers — In a world of uncertainty, we are a team of curious minds, who embrace the uncertain, creating a life of learning, exploration and inspiration. At JMC we grow our voice to be confident and unstoppable. We aren’t afraid to fall, as we know we will rise.
  • Inclusive Community of Connectors — We create meaningful pathways, only possible through our connections and impact.
  • Empathetic & Compassionate Leaders — We care about every individual who walks through our doors, with kindness in our hearts and purpose in our minds.
  • Honest, Accountable & of Uncompromising Quality — Our honesty, integrity and quality will not be compromised, as we strive to achieve our best. We are determined to reach our goals, as we hold ourselves and each other accountable.

YOUR ROLE, HONESTLY

The CRM Automation & Personalisation Specialist is a hands-on specialist role within JMC’s Customer function, reporting to the Head of Digital.

This position is responsible for the practical deployment and ongoing optimisation of JMC’s marketing automation activities using HubSpot. The role is focused on building scalable automation, sophisticated segmentation and dynamic personalisation across email, SMS and web touchpoints, ensuring communications are timely, relevant and data-informed throughout the student journey.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

CRM & PLATFORM OWNERSHIP

  • Own day-to-day administration, configuration and optimisation of the marketing automation and segmentation functions in HubSpot
  • Maintain key platform assets including properties, audiences, lists, subscriptions, email templates, forms, workflows and lifecycle logic

AUTOMATION & JOURNEY DESIGN

  • Design, build and optimise automated workflows, nurture programs and triggered communications across the student lifecycle
  • Develop advanced segmentation and personalisation strategies using behavioural, demographic, lifecycle and engagement data
  • Implement dynamic content and cross-channel journey logic across email, SMS and web to improve relevance and conversion

DATA, REPORTING & OPTIMISATION

  • Maintain strong data quality across CRM records, audience structures and connected systems
  • Support data imports, custom datasets, reporting structures and dashboard development to measure campaign and journey effectiveness
  • Conduct A/B and multivariate testing to improve engagement, conversion and operational efficiency over time

INTEGRATION & COLLABORATION

  • Work with Product, Data and Technology stakeholders to support integration requirements and CRM best practice
  • Assist with implementation and enhancement initiatives relating to CRM technology and lifecycle automation
  • Provide training, documentation and practical support to internal stakeholders using the CRM and related automation tools

COMPLIANCE & CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT

  • Ensure communication activity aligns with privacy, consent and spam compliance requirements
  • Monitor performance, identify issues and implement improvements across journeys, workflows and platform usage
  • Stay current with emerging CRM, automation and personalisation capabilities, and apply them where they create practical value

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

This role suits a hands-on CRM and marketing automation specialist who is the technical go-to for automation, segmentation and platform configuration, someone with the analytical capability and attention to detail to turn prospect and student data into timely, relevant, personalised communications at scale.

ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS

  • 3–5 years’ experience in CRM management, marketing automation, lifecycle marketing or a related technical digital role
  • Strong hands-on experience with platforms such as HubSpot and Salesforce Marketing Cloud, including being the technical go-to for automation, segmentation and platform configuration
  • Demonstrated success building sophisticated nurture journeys, dynamic content and personalisation logic across campaigns or cross-channel programs
  • Strong working knowledge of CRM data structures, list and consent management and reporting
  • Experience with APIs, integrations, custom datasets and troubleshooting data flows
  • Practical capability in tools and languages such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Liquid, SQL or equivalent platforms used in marketing automation environments
  • Strong analytical capability, attention to detail and confidence using data to improve outcomes
  • Ability to work autonomously, manage competing priorities and collaborate effectively across technical and non-technical teams

HIGHLY REGARDED

  • Experience supporting a CRM implementation or major platform uplift program
  • Experience in higher education or another complex multi-stage service environment
  • Familiarity with student recruitment funnels, enquiry nurturing and enrolment lifecycle design
  • Platform certifications relevant to CRM or marketing automation

WHY THIS ROLE

  • A CAPABILITY TO BUILD — you lead the build, optimisation and ongoing evolution of JMC’s CRM and lifecycle marketing capability — genuine ownership of a maturing environment.
  • MEASURABLE IMPACT — your automation, segmentation and personalisation work drives measurable improvements in enquiry, application, offer and enrolment performance.
  • DEEP SPECIALIST CRAFT — a hands-on specialist role at the intersection of CRM operations, marketing automation, personalisation, data quality and journey optimisation.
  • FLEXIBLE LOCATION — based in Melbourne, Sydney or Brisbane with hybrid working, supporting the student journey across all JMC campuses.
  • COMPETITIVE REMUNERATION & BENEFITS — salary commensurate with experience, plus professional development support, staff scholarship access to JMC courses, hybrid working and a genuinely distinctive creative community.

THE PRACTICAL BITS

BASE Sydney, Melbourne or Brisbane, with hybrid working and some in-office presence for collaboration and key events.

REPORTS TO Head of Digital Channels

TYPE Full time, permanent.

SALARY Competitive, commensurate with experience; we’ll talk specifics early in the process.

WHAT TO SEND

A CV and a cover letter outlining your interest in the position and how you meet the criteria listed in the position description

Our Mission: Quality, compassionate care for all.

Our Vision: Reimagine health care through connection, service and innovation.

Our Core Values: Be Kind | Trust and Be Trusted | Work Together | Strive for Excellence.





Why Join Logan Health's Surgical & Oncology Unit?

Our Surgical & Oncology Unit cares for a wide range of patients, including Orthopedic, Neurology, Thoracic, Urology, and Surgical Oncology populations. As part of our team, you'll provide specialized care to oncology patients receiving inpatient chemotherapy, symptom management, and supportive treatments while collaborating closely with physicians, pharmacists, and multidisciplinary care teams.

This role offers the opportunity to develop expertise in oncology nursing while maintaining a broad clinical skill set in a fast-paced acute care environment.

What You'll Do

  • Administer and monitor inpatient chemotherapy treatments in accordance with established protocols and safety standards.

  • Assess, educate, and support oncology patients and their families throughout their treatment journey.

  • Collaborate with oncologists, pharmacists, and interdisciplinary team members to coordinate comprehensive patient care.

  • Deliver individualized, evidence-based nursing care to patients with complex medical, surgical, and oncology needs.

  • Monitor for treatment-related side effects, complications, and changes in patient condition, ensuring timely intervention and escalation when needed.

  • Care for a variety of surgical patients, including those recovering from thoracic procedures, colectomies, Whipple procedures, and other complex surgeries.

What We Offer

  • Work-Life Balance: Enjoy flexible 12-hour shifts with self-scheduling options and no on-call requirements.

  • Specialized Oncology Experience: Gain valuable experience administering inpatient chemotherapy and caring for oncology patients with complex treatment needs.

  • Professional Growth: Expand your clinical expertise through exposure to advanced therapies, multidisciplinary collaboration, and ongoing learning opportunities.

  • Supportive Team Culture: Work alongside experienced nurses and providers committed to delivering exceptional patient care.

What Makes You a Great Fit

You are a compassionate and clinically skilled RN who thrives in a collaborative environment. You are passionate about oncology nursing, committed to patient advocacy, and confident in managing complex patient needs. You bring strong critical thinking, communication, and assessment skills and are dedicated to delivering safe, high-quality care to every patient.

Make an Impact

Apply today to join Logan Health's Surgical & Oncology Unit and become part of a team dedicated to providing exceptional oncology and surgical care while supporting patients through some of their most important healthcare journeys

Surgical / Oncology Unit Flyer

Qualifications:

  • Current Montana RN license or a multi state compact license with authorization to practice nursing within the state of Montana; required. BSN degree preferred.

  • Minimum of two (2) years’ experience in similar position within a medical setting (eg, physician office, clinic, or hospital) preferred. Experience in assigned area(s) preferred.

  • Possess knowledge of professional nursing theory, medical terminology and principles of professional nursing practice to administer and evaluate patient care.

  • Healthcare Provider (HCP) CPR and/or BLS certification required as dictated by each practice/service line.

  • Ability and willingness to obtain Chemotherapy Provider certification/card within one (1) year of employment required. Understanding of the confidentiality laws that govern the provider-patient relationship, including but not limited to, HIPAA guidelines.

  • Knowledge of equipment, supplies, and instruments used in a medical office; simple routine clinical laboratory methods, universal blood and body fluid precautions.

  • Must have knowledge of OSHA rules and regulations, established protocol for storing poisons, narcotics, acids, caustics, and flammable items; restriction imposed by various manage care carriers, various forms inherent to profession.

  • Excellent organizational skills, detail-oriented, a self-starter, possess critical thinking skills and be able to set priorities and function as part of a team as well as independently. Commitment to working in a team environment and maintaining confidentiality as needed.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills including the ability to communicate effectively with various audiences.

  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to manage sensitive and confidential situations with tact, professionalism, and diplomacy. Possess considerable knowledge of the behavior and needs of patients.

  • Possess and maintain computer skills to include working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite and ability to learn other software as needed.

Job Specific Duties:

  • Develops, implements and coordinates individualized, goal directed nursing care to patients through the use of the nursing process as appropriate for RN’s as applicable to the assigned area(s).

  • Maintains nursing standards of care and responds to changing workloads and patient conditions by: remaining calm, making objective assessments, prioritizing, and asking for assistance as appropriate.

  • Transcribes and implements provider orders and treatments both verbal and written accurately and efficiently as noted by chart reviews and observation. Consistently problem solves issues affecting patient care.

  • Exhibits a thorough practice of infection control procedures per policy and procedure as applicable to the assigned area(s).

  • Identifies, verbally evaluates, and reports identified reaction changes in the stated physical and mental conditions of patients.

  • Documents all encounters with patients seeking health advice according to organizational standards, while clearly demonstrating the nursing process.

  • Provides individual instruction and education to patients and families concerning health and medical needs per department protocol and as applicable to assigned area(s).

  • Assesses and anticipates the needs of the patient, and coordinates the necessary interventions as defined by policy, procedure and the written/verbal orders of the provider as applicable to assigned area(s).

  • Consistently problem solves issues effecting patient care.

The above essential functions are representative of major duties of positions in this job classification. Specific duties and responsibilities may vary based upon departmental needs. Other duties may be assigned similar to the above consistent with knowledge, skills and abilities required for the job. Not all of the duties may be assigned to a position.

Maintains regular and consistent attendance as scheduled by department leadership.

Logan Health operates 24 hours per day, seven days per week. Schedules are set to accommodate the requirements of the position and the needs of the organization and may be adjusted as needed.

title: Universal Joint Task List Analyst
description:
Universal Joint Task List Analyst

The Opportunity:

As a Defense Mission Professional, you understand that the Universal Joint Task List (UJTL) is more than a catalog of tasks—it is a foundational readiness and training framework that directly shapes how the Joint Force assesses mission capability, develops training programs, and aligns operational requirements. You think critically, question assumptions, and help bring structure to complex operational environments. We’re looking for someone like you to help sustain and advance the UJTL program that underpins joint readiness across Combatant Commands, Services, and Defense Agencies.

As a Senior UJTL Analyst, you will apply deep operational expertise, analytical skill, and joint process knowledge to develop, maintain, and refine UJTL tasks and associated products. You’ll collaborate with Joint Staff, Combatant Commands, Services, UJTL stakeholders, working groups, and doctrine teams to ensure the UJTL remains accurate, relevant, aligned with approved policy, and responsive to emerging concepts. Your role also contributes directly to readiness reporting, training development, joint planning, and the integration of UJTL content across doctrine, systems, and policy publications.

You’ll support authoritative and non-authoritative change requests, maintain and update UJTL databases and conditions, deliver training to Organizational Points of Contact (OPOCs) and stakeholders, prepare publication action reports, develop UJTL crosswalks supporting concepts and wargames, and help align UJTL updates with joint doctrine. Through your operational experience and communication skills, you ensure that UJTL products remain clear, structured, validated, and ready for integration across joint readiness, planning, and training communities.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • Experience with Joint Mission Essential Task Lists (JMETLs), the Universal Joint Task List (UJTL), and Master Training Plans (MTP)

  • Experience developing, maintaining, coordinating, and delivering user training to CCMD and Joint Task Force Headquarters staff

  • Experience conducting task analysis, processing change requests, and delivering recommendations to government program managers

  • Knowledge of Joint Staff structure, mission, programs, and organizational relationships, including relationships with CCMDs, Services, and Defense Agencies

  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships across stakeholders

  • TS/SCI clearance

  • Bachelor’s degree and 3+ years of experience with operational warfighting or 7+ years of experience with operational warfighting in lieu of a degree

Nice If You Have:

  • Experience preparing and conducting working groups, including developing and presenting briefings tailored to senior audiences

  • Experience developing UJTL crosswalks supporting wargames, exercises, concepts, or readiness reporting

  • Experience supporting UJTL-related working groups, Users Advisory Groups (UUAG), and coordination with Joint Staff divisions

  • Experience developing staffing packages and adjudicating UJTL change actions

  • Knowledge of the Joint Doctrine process and how UJTL content aligns with doctrine development, revision, and adjudication

  • Knowledge of project management principles applied to staffing packages, reviews, coordination timelines, and publication actions

  • Knowledge of joint doctrine alignment processes for updating UJTL citations in Joint Publications following doctrine revision cycles

  • Possession of strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills

Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance is required.

The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

description:

Job Title: Geotechnical Field Engineer

Location: Mukwonago, WI

The Geotechnical Field Engineer will support the planning, execution, and oversight of geothermal well drilling operations in the field. This role involves technical supervision, coordination with contractors and crews, and ensuring compliance with safety, environmental, and engineering standards. The Field Engineer will be responsible for monitoring drilling activities, troubleshooting issues, and implementing solutions to ensure efficient and safe delivery of geothermal wells.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide field engineering support during all phases of geothermal drilling projects.
  • Monitor drilling parameters, wellbore conditions, and equipment performance to ensure adherence to the drilling program.
  • Work closely with the Drilling Superintendent, Drilling Manager, and contractors to implement drilling plans and resolve technical challenges.
  • Ensure compliance with health, safety, and environmental (HSE) regulations and company policies.
  • Conduct daily reporting of drilling activities, equipment usage, consumables, and progress against plan.
  • Assist with well design, casing and cementing programs, mud programs, and testing procedures.
  • Evaluate drilling data to optimize performance, reduce non-productive time, and mitigate risks.
  • Participate in troubleshooting drilling issues such as stuck pipe, lost circulation, or downhole equipment failures.
  • Coordinate with vendors and service providers for tools, materials, and support services.
  • Support cost tracking and verify contractor invoices against field records.
  • Assist with post-drilling reviews, lessons learned, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Key Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Geothermal Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field (or equivalent work experience).
  • 2+ years of field experience in drilling, preferably geothermal, oil & gas, or deep foundation projects.
  • Strong understanding of drilling rig operations, downhole tools, and well construction.
  • Familiarity with drilling fluids, cementing, casing, and directional drilling practices.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to adapt in fast-changing field environments.
  • Proficient in drilling software, Microsoft Office Suite, and data acquisition systems.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
  • Willingness to work in remote field locations and on a rotational schedule, as required.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with geothermal well drilling and associated challenges.
  • Knowledge of geothermal reservoir engineering concepts.
  • Familiarity with environmental compliance requirements for geothermal projects

  • Opportunities for career advancement.

title: Applied Philosophy Benchmark Specialist
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking expert philosophers to author and review high-quality academic assessment content for an AI research initiative. You will write and verify rigorous multiple-choice questions across core philosophy domains, evaluate solution quality, and help establish gold-standard benchmarks used to advance AI capabilities.

You will be assigned one of two task types:

  • Question Authoring — Create original, challenging multiple-choice questions in your area of philosophy expertise, rate their difficulty, and submit them for review.

  • Question Verification — Review pre-written questions for accuracy, clarity, and rigor. Edit where needed, rate difficulty, and document any changes made.

Philosophy Domains Covered

Formal Ontology & Knowledge Representation, AI Ethics, Applied Epistemology, Philosophy of Technology & Robotics, Philosophy of Science.

Key Responsibilities

  • Author original philosophy questions that test deep conceptual understanding, not surface-level recall

  • Ensure questions are unambiguous, self-contained, and precisely defined — all necessary information must be in the problem statement

  • Rate each question’s difficulty: Medium (intro undergraduate), Hard (advanced undergraduate), or Expert (post-graduate and above)

  • Provide 1 correct answer and 9 plausible but subtly incorrect alternatives that challenge expert-level solvers

  • Write step-by-step Chain-of-Thought solutions with clear, concise reasoning in markdown format

  • Supply 1–5 academic references per question from reputable sources (peer-reviewed journals, university repositories)

  • For verification tasks: flag issues with clarity, completeness, precision, or solvability and justify any edits made

Ideal Qualifications

  • PhD or doctoral candidate in Philosophy or a closely related field

  • Master’s degree considered for candidates with exceptional depth in a specific subdomain

  • Strong command of philosophical argumentation, formal logic, and canonical texts across traditions

  • Research publications or teaching experience in philosophy is a strong plus

  • Excellent written English and ability to express complex ideas clearly and concisely

More About the Opportunity

  • Expected commitment: 10+ hours/week

  • Asynchronous, fully remote work

title: Technical Infrastructure Program Manager, Infra Operations Planning Team
description:
Description

G'day! You've found an opportunity that could define your next chapter.

Applicants must be Australian citizens and hold or be eligible to obtain an Australian Government Security Clearance with the ability to successfully complete an Organisational Suitability Assessment. More information regarding security clearances can be found at https://www.agsva.gov.au/.

The Mission - Why This Program, Why Now?
You're joining at the defining moment of one of the most significant technology programmes Australia has ever undertaken. This programme will build and operate the dedicated cloud giving Australia's national security community and its allies the capability to see more, share more, innovate and act faster than ever before.
The architectural decisions being made now - how we structure networking, implement security controls, and automate at scale - will shape how Australia's national security community operates for the next decade. You won't be inheriting someone else's design choices. You'll be making them.

Your Role in This Story
Imagine orchestrating the full lifecycle of some of the most critical data centre infrastructure in the country — from the first blueprint to the final rack installation and beyond. As a Technical Program Manager within AWS Global Infrastructure Operations, you'll be the connective tissue between engineering vision and operational reality, bringing together networking, capacity planning, construction, and service delivery teams to build and scale high-availability environments that never sleep.

This isn't programme management from a desk. You'll be shaping how Australia's cloud infrastructure is designed, built, and operated — influencing everything from headcount models and cabling architecture to network builds and hardware decommissioning strategies. The decisions you drive today will determine how securely and efficiently this nation's most sensitive workloads run for years to come.

You'll thrive here if you're energised by complexity, motivated by national purpose, and ready to lead cross-functional teams through ambiguity toward outcomes that genuinely matter. This is your chance to combine deep technical programme management expertise with the rare opportunity to build something from the ground up — at a scale few programmes in Australia can match.

Benefits
- Learning & development - AWS training and certification support, access to internal learning platforms.
- Health, income protection and life cover
- Amazon subsidises private health insurance premiums, and group salary continuance and life insurance are included at no cost to you
- Military differential pay launching in Australia - Australian employees taking defence reserve leave may receive up to 52 weeks of military differential pay to help cover the difference in pay while serving
- Employee Assistance Program - Free, confidential support 24 hours a day, 7 days a week for you and your family - mental health, financial coaching, legal questions, and everyday life events.
- Family-building benefit - Access to Maven for fertility treatment, adoption support, surrogacy, and parenting coaching
- Amazon Extras & employee discount - cashback and discounts across hundreds of retail, fitness, travel, and lifestyle partners.

Key Responsibilities
You'll serve as the critical bridge between Infrastructure Operations, Networking TPMs, Capacity and Construction teams, and service delivery organisations — ensuring that every data centre build and cross-departmental initiative moves forward with precision and purpose.

Your impact will span the strategic to the tactical. You'll participate in region-level planning and forecasting, translating long-term vision into executable roadmaps while managing multiple large-scale process re-engineering efforts simultaneously. When existing processes don't serve the mission, you'll redesign them. When cross-functional workflows lack clarity, you'll document and standardise them so teams can move faster with confidence.

You'll develop and communicate project roadmaps that keep dozens of stakeholders aligned, prioritise ruthlessly across competing demands, and ensure that every milestone drives toward operational excellence. Your written and verbal communication skills will be your superpower — distilling complexity into clarity for audiences ranging from engineers to senior leadership.

This role carries travel requirements of up to 25%, giving you direct visibility into the environments you're helping build and the teams you're empowering. You'll also take on strategic tasks as directed by senior leadership, positioning you at the intersection of operational delivery and programme strategy.

Basic Qualifications

- 2+ years of technical product or program management experience

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience leading process improvement, systems development, and project management
- 2+ years of directly managing and responsible for multiple large projects experience
- 2+ years of project management, including resource planning, managing schedules, reporting project status and prioritizing tasks experience

title: GTM AI Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Join the team rewriting the rules in private markets.

Moonfare delivers what few others can: the highly sought-after funds and hidden-gem investments that go beyond what most private banks offer. Every opportunity is subjected to a ruthless vetting process; the bar is unforgivingly high. The result? Institutional-quality portfolios for investors who demand more.

Our team combines finance veterans with talent from tech, consulting, law and industries you’d never expect. Headquartered in Berlin, we operate from eight offices across Europe, the US and Asia.

If you're ready to build what's next in private markets, let's talk.

GTM AI Engineer (m/f/d)

This newly created role will join Moonfare’s AI & Transformation team as part of the GTM Engineering function. You will be responsible for building and scaling Moonfare’s commercial systems and processes. The team sits at the intersection of Investor Relations (Sales), Account Management, Marketing, and Product, owning the infrastructure, data, and automation that power revenue generation. As we’re getting started, we will automate 1-2 processes per quarter. This team is responsible for the CRM system, commercial processes, and performance monitoring.

You will turn manual processes into automated and agentic workflows across lead generation, scoring, routing, and outreach, directly impacting revenue and efficiency. The challenge is making AI work in a complex regulated system with a long sales cycle and not just in theory. This is a high-impact role shaping how AI is applied in production across our commercial teams.

Your Mission:

  • Build and maintain automation in HubSpot (workflows, lead routing, lifecycle management)
  • Define and own the architecture of Moonfare's AI-driven GTM engine, setting the standards for how automation and AI are built, evaluated, and scaled across commercial teams
  • Design and implement lead scoring models (rules-based + AI-assisted)
  • Manage HubSpot connectors to Claude and other tools
  • Improve data, lead generation, and enrichment processes (within compliant sources)
  • Turn manual GTM processes and turn them into scalable agentic processes
  • Continuously build and implement AI-driven automation use cases across GTM engineering and commercial teams, from idea to production

The next Moonfarian:

  • You bring an extensive track record working with HubSpot
  • Strong understanding of CRM architecture and data models
  • Experience with complex workflows and automation
  • Hands-on use of LLMs (e.g. Claude) in production workflows via tools like n8n, APIs, or similar automation frameworks
  • Passion to coach others on AI and multiply the knowledge
  • Experience applying AI to lead scoring, prioritization, personalization, data classification, enrichment
  • Familiarity with APIs and integrations
  • Ability to integrate AI into systems

If you feel you do not meet all of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply!

Please Note: We can only accept applications from those eligible to live and work in Berlin. This is a hybrid role with office attendance required 4 days/week. We do not accept applications sent by email. You should submit your application directly through our careers website.

Invest in yourself:

  • Ownership and Impact: You are empowered to bring ideas, make decisions, and see your work directly contribute to Moonfare's success.
    Transparent Environment: We believe in open communication. You will receive regular updates on company strategy, performance against our KPIs, and key business decisions.
  • Personal Growth: We support your development with an individual growth budget of €1,500 or 2% of your base salary (whichever is higher).
  • Invest in Your Future: We support your long-term financial goals with a company pension scheme, providing a 20% employer contribution.
  • Relax and Recharge: You start with 25 vacation days and you’ll receive one additional day for each year of tenure, up to a maximum of 30 days.
  • Daily Lunch: Enjoy a free lunch every day that you are in the Berlin office, with a weekly changing menu that includes salads, curries, pastas, and a variety of vegan and vegetarian options.
  • Subsidised Public Transport: We support your commute with a monthly subsidy for the Deutschland job ticket, making your travel easier and more affordable.
  • Fitness and Wellbeing: Stay active with a subsidised Urban Sports Club membership, giving you flexible access to a wide variety of sports and wellness activities across Germany.
  • A Culture of Excellence: Join a team of ambitious, smart, and committed professionals who are passionate about revolutionising private market investing.

Our Values:

  • Client-Centric Focus: Our clients come first, Moonfare comes second, and we prioritise ourselves third. Putting clients first means creating value for them is essential. Placing Moonfare second signifies that our individual professional future at Moonfare depends on the company's commercial success. Prioritising ourselves third reflects our humility in putting clients and Moonfare before personal interests.
  • Commitment to Excellence: We pursue excellence and honor our promises. We hold ourselves to the highest standards, taking responsibility for our failures, and celebrating our successes. We commit to deadlines and stick to them and we learn from our mistakes.
  • Win together: We are here to win and to celebrate our collective achievements. We are mission-focused and think and act like owners. We exemplify the attitude we expect and each of us commits to do what it takes to succeed.
  • Growth and Merit: We foster personal growth but each of us earns our place as a Moonfarian through merit. We hire, retain, and develop exceptional people and invest in empowering them to excel. We must all earn our place at the table every day.

We understand the important role that diversity plays in our success. Different backgrounds, experiences and ideas push us further and raise the bar. We’re committed to developing an inclusive and safe culture where everyone—regardless of colour, race, religion, sex, origin, sexuality, disability, marital status, citizenship or gender identity—knows that they are an integral part of the team and can bring their full potential to their work.

title: Logistics Management Analyst 3 - Space AHT
description:
RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: No relocation assistance available

CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: Yes

CLEARANCE TYPE: Secret

TRAVEL: Yes, 10% of the Time

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Overview

Reporting to the Depot Distribution Center Lead, the Logistics Management Analyst (ADM03) is responsible for day‑to‑day warehouse and distribution operations within the Depot Distribution Center (DDC). This role performs a combination of manual and clerical duties to receive, store, pick, pack, stage, and issue equipment, materials, and supplies in support of depot maintenance and repair activities. The Logistics Management Analyst ensures inventory accuracy, proper material handling, and timely movement of material to internal and external customers while maintaining a safe, compliant, and well‑organized warehouse environment.

Job Responsibilities

Receiving & Inspection

  • Receive incoming materials, parts, and equipment at the Depot Distribution Center.
  • Verify item counts, part numbers, and documentation against packing lists, manifests, and purchase/transfer orders.
  • Inspect incoming items for visible damage, mismatched labels, or discrepancies and escalate issues for resolution.
  • Record receipts in the inventory/ERP system (e.g., SAP) and generate appropriate labels, tags, or barcodes.

Put‑Away & Storage

  • Place received items into assigned storage locations (bins, racks, shelves) in accordance with established storage plans and handling requirements.
  • Ensure items are stored by part number, condition, and hazard/safety requirements to support traceability and compliance.
  • Maintain accurate location data in the system so material can be quickly located and issued.

Inventory Control & Cycle Counting

  • Perform routine cycle counts and full physical inventories as directed.
  • Compare physical counts to system quantities, investigate discrepancies (e.g., mis‑picks, mis‑labels, unrecorded moves), and support corrections in the system.
  • Monitor and help maintain minimum/maximum levels for key stock items; alert the Depot Distribution Center Lead to potential stock‑out or overstock conditions.
  • Assist with reconciliation of inventory reports and preparation of inventory accuracy metrics.

Picking, Kitting & Material Staging

  • Pick material to support internal work orders, maintenance/repair activities, and customer requirements using system‑generated pick lists.
  • Build and stage kits of parts for scheduled work, ensuring correct quantities, part numbers, and configurations.
  • Verify that all required components are present before releasing material to internal customers or downstream processes.
  • Return unused or excess material to stock, updating records to maintain inventory accuracy.

Packing, Shipping & Internal Transfers

  • Pack materials for internal transfers and outbound shipments in accordance with company procedures and any applicable handling requirements.
  • Prepare packing lists, manifests, and other shipping documentation needed for internal moves and external deliveries.
  • Coordinate with transportation, couriers, or other logistics functions to schedule pickups and deliveries.
  • Track shipments as required and support resolution of late, lost, or damaged shipments.

Data Entry, Documentation & Systems Use

  • Enter and update transactions (receipts, issues, transfers, adjustments) in SAP or other designated inventory/warehouse management systems.
  • Maintain accurate paper and electronic records of receipts, issues, returns, and inventory adjustments to support audits and traceability.
  • Run basic system queries and reports (e.g., on‑hand balances, open picks, aging inventory) to support Depot Distribution Center operations.

Housekeeping, Safety & Equipment Care

  • Maintain clean, organized, and safe warehouse and stockroom areas, including aisles, bins, staging areas, and workstations.
  • Comply with all safety procedures, PPE requirements, and material handling guidelines.
  • Perform basic care and pre‑use checks on material handling equipment (e.g., pallet jacks, carts, forklifts if licensed) and report any issues.

Coordination & Customer Support

  • Coordinate with Production, Engineering, Quality, Program Management, and other internal customers to validate material availability and resolve material issues.
  • Support customer walk‑up requests and provide status updates on material location, availability, and shipment status.
  • Communicate clearly and professionally with team members and other departments to keep work flowing and resolve problems quickly.

Process Compliance & Continuous Improvement

  • Follow established Depot Distribution Center procedures, work instructions, and quality standards for all warehouse activities.
  • Identify opportunities to improve material flow, reduce errors, increase inventory accuracy, and better utilize warehouse space.
  • Participate in process improvement or corrective‑action activities as assigned by the Depot Distribution Center Lead.

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience working in a warehouse, stockroom, distribution center, depot, or similar material handling environment.

  • Basic understanding of inventory control, storage methods, and material handling practices.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel for data entry, tracking, and basic reporting.

  • Experience using an enterprise inventory or warehouse management system (e.g., SAP or similar).

  • Ability to obtain a DoD Secret clearance within a reasonable amount of time as determined by the company to meet its business needs.

  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team in a fast‑paced depot environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience in a depot, repair/overhaul logistics, or sustainment support environment.

  • Knowledge and use of ERP/MRP and/or warehouse management systems for inventory transactions and reporting.

  • Advanced experience with Microsoft Excel (e.g., pivot tables, lookups, filters, and/or macros).

  • Active, in‑scope DoD Secret clearance.

  • Ability to read basic technical drawings and bills of material to verify part numbers and configurations.

Physical Requirements

  • Physically able to complete required tasks such as walking, standing, lifting, bending, and working in a loud warehouse environment.

  • Ability to safely lift and move materials in accordance with established ergonomic and safety guidelines, with or without reasonable accommodation.

  • Occasional travel to the Redstone Gateway location if/when required.

Primary Level Salary Range: $81,800.00 - $122,600.00

The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions.

Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives. In addition, Northrop Grumman provides a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, Company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO) for vacation and/or personal business.

The application period for the job is estimated to be 20 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates.
